# D07 Relationships, Trust, Loyalty, and Order Evaluation: Operating Contract and Official Sheet

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/relationships-houses-and-intrigue/)

Separate directed trust, an individual's perception and memory, loyalty state, order compliance, and after-the-fact performance. Past decisions are not rewritten using facts that were not observed, and per-effect values, decay, duration, and real-world person and institution inputs are deferred.

Status: a scoped operating contract. It distinguishes the public Lite's reference calculations, Seoul's approved procedures and preservation rules, and unapproved proposals. A proposal-held item is a deferred entry that cannot be executed, and it is neither 0 nor an approved figure. This document does not imply full-domain numerical completion or a runtime implementation.

[Domain Design](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d07/) · [Individual Sheets and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [Saves and Versions](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [Singleplayer Contract](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## Processing Order and Responsibility Boundaries

1. Verify the permanent identity and the rule/snapshot revisions, and reject duplicate results first.
2. Separate world facts from the observer's perception, authority, feasibility, actions, and observed outcomes.
3. Only an observer who directly observed the event or received a report updates the corresponding perception record.
4. If there is no approved effect function, do not change trust or loyalty values.
5. Classify order compliance and performance separately, and do not turn an impossible order into deliberate disobedience.
6. Preserve the successor's existing relationships and do not copy the predecessor's personal trust.
7. Apply the attributed outcome together with the settlement identifier, and preserve relationship facts and contracts.

## Normalized Data and Formula Contract

Declare together the owner, read/write scope, units, snapshot, and point of application. Validation of formats and conservation formulas does not substitute for actual ledger issuance or the adoption of undecided functions. rulesVersion and the hash of the linked canonical source identify the source version and do not create any arbitrary new execution version.

# D07 관계·신뢰·충성·명령 평가 작동 계약과 공식 시트

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다.

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/relationships-houses-and-intrigue/)

방향이 있는 신뢰, 개인의 인지와 기억, 충성 상태, 명령 준수와 사후 성과를 분리한다. 관측하지 못한 사실로 과거 결정을 다시 쓰지 않으며, 효과별 수치·감쇠·지속 기간과 실제 인물·기관 입력은 보류한다.

상태: 범위가 한정된 작동 계약. 공개 Lite의 참조 계산, 서울의 승인된 절차·보존 규칙, 미승인 제안을 구분한다. proposal-held는 실행할 수 없는 보류 항목이며 0이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 이 문서는 전체 도메인 수치 완성이나 런타임 구현을 뜻하지 않는다.

[도메인 설계](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d07/) · [개인 시트와 계산](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [저장과 판본](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [싱글플레이 계약](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 처리 순서와 책임 경계

1. 영구 신원과 규칙·스냅샷 개정을 확인하고 중복 결과를 먼저 거부한다.
2. 세계 사실과 관찰자의 인지, 권한, 실행 가능성, 행동, 관측 성과를 분리한다.
3. 직접 관측하거나 보고를 받은 관찰자만 해당 인지 기록을 갱신한다.
4. 승인된 효과 함수가 없으면 신뢰·충성 수치를 변경하지 않는다.
5. 명령 준수와 성과를 따로 분류하고 불가능한 명령을 고의 불복종으로 바꾸지 않는다.
6. 후계자의 기존 관계를 보존하고 선대의 개인 신뢰를 복사하지 않는다.
7. 귀속된 결과와 정산 식별자를 함께 반영하고 관계 사실·계약을 보존한다.

## 정규화된 데이터·공식 계약

소유자, 읽기·쓰기 범위, 단위, 스냅샷과 반영 시점을 함께 선언한다. 형식과 보존식의 검증은 실제 원장 발급이나 미정 함수의 채택을 대신하지 않는다. rulesVersion과 연결 정본의 해시는 원천 판본을 식별하며 임의의 새 실행 판본을 만들지 않는다.

title_ko: D09 세력·정체·기관·직위 작동 계약과 공식 시트
body_md:
# D09 Factions, Polities, Institutions, and Offices: Operating Contract and Official Sheet

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/power-and-institutions/)

Procedure records by polity and office distinguish candidate eligibility, voters, quorum, tie resolution, examinations, appointment and confirmation, and the scope of acting authority. A vacancy does not delete the institution, treasury, debt, or lineage, and the procedure values and numerical legitimacy of the actual polities are withheld.

Status: a scoped operating contract. It distinguishes the public Lite's reference calculations, Seoul's approved procedures and preservation rules, and unapproved proposals. A proposal-held item is a deferred entry that cannot be executed, and it is neither 0 nor an approved figure. This document does not imply full-domain numerical completion or a runtime implementation.

[Domain Design](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d09/) · [Character Sheet and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [Saving and Editions](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [Singleplayer Contract](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## Processing Order and Responsibility Boundaries

1. Cross-check the permanent IDs and editions of the faction (polity), institution, office, and procedure.
2. Loss of an office vacates only the target office and preserves the institution, treasury, and other offices.
3. If there is no approved, complete procedure input for the relevant faction (polity) and office, no appointment is made.
4. Filter candidates by the stated eligibility and by the examination unit and criteria.
5. Cross-check valid voters against votes, and apply only the registered quorum and tie rules.
6. After confirming the appointing authority and the required confirming authority, reflect the office and categorical legitimacy together.
7. Acting authority permits only registered persons and action scopes, and does not convert into ownership of the office.
8. Loading restores the previous result and does not rerun the election.

## Normalized Data and Formula Contract

Declare together the owner, read/write scope, units, snapshot, and point of application. Validation of formats and conservation formulas does not substitute for actual ledger issuance or the adoption of undecided functions. rulesVersion and the hash of the linked canonical source identify the source version and do not create any arbitrary new execution version.

# D09 세력·정체·기관·직위 작동 계약과 공식 시트

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다.

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/power-and-institutions/)

정체·직위별 절차 기록으로 후보 자격, 선거인, 정족수, 동률 해결, 시험, 임명·인준과 대행 범위를 구분한다. 공석은 기관·국고·부채·계보를 삭제하지 않으며 실제 정치체의 절차 값과 수치 정통성은 보류한다.

상태: 범위가 한정된 작동 계약. 공개 Lite의 참조 계산, 서울의 승인된 절차·보존 규칙, 미승인 제안을 구분한다. proposal-held는 실행할 수 없는 보류 항목이며 0이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 이 문서는 전체 도메인 수치 완성이나 런타임 구현을 뜻하지 않는다.

[도메인 설계](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d09/) · [개인 시트와 계산](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [저장과 판본](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [싱글플레이 계약](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 처리 순서와 책임 경계

1. 세력(정체)·기관·직위·절차의 영구 ID와 판본을 대조한다.
2. 직위 상실은 대상 직위만 비우며 기관·국고·다른 직위를 보존한다.
3. 해당 세력(정체)·직위의 승인된 완전한 절차 입력이 없으면 임명하지 않는다.
4. 명시된 자격과 시험 단위·기준으로 후보를 거른다.
5. 유효 선거인과 투표를 대조하고 등록된 정족수와 동률 규칙만 적용한다.
6. 임명권자와 필요한 인준권자를 확인한 뒤 직위·범주형 정통성을 함께 반영한다.
7. 대행은 등록된 사람과 행위 범위만 허용하며 직위 소유로 바꾸지 않는다.
8. 불러오기는 이전 결과를 복원하며 선출을 재실행하지 않는다.

## 정규화된 데이터·공식 계약

소유자, 읽기·쓰기 범위, 단위, 스냅샷과 반영 시점을 함께 선언한다. 형식과 보존식의 검증은 실제 원장 발급이나 미정 함수의 채택을 대신하지 않는다. rulesVersion과 연결 정본의 해시는 원천 판본을 식별하며 임의의 새 실행 판본을 만들지 않는다.

# Node States

The twelve ids are architecture nodes that distinguish the states and records of different owners. They are not global progression stages that pass through characters, houses, places, and screens in turn. Characters and squads carry out their own actions in the same world time, and when the conditions of a command or event are met, only the relevant targets change state. Events also occur in living spaces, and selecting a map or panel does not stop the actions of unrelated targets. The arrow in each row means a legal state change of that target or a link between records. Life, the strategic map, and combat are screens that differ in the space and information they display, and they do not own world progression. This table is a design contract for the product goals; the implementation status is confirmed in separate verification records. The table's GDD citations are fixed-tree line numbers at `bedb366d6eb1d884bce39f4dd3cf3ab9890b0403`, and the old worldbuilding citations of the places row are fixed-tree line numbers in a separate repository at `84040eb7124f4e6e779b42e7e3c091f71bbdbac8`. The worldbuilding grounds of the house, atlas and ecology rows are sections of this repository's canon bible (`docs/CANON-BIBLE.md`) and v3 chapters (`docs/design/v3/`).

| id | Independent State Dimensions | Legal Outgoing Transitions and Guards | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| character | A hero's roster state is exactly one of commander, attached, independent agent, or unavailable. Each hero has one primary combat class and a secondary role tag (owner decision of 2026-09-24), and the six class names are still proposals. Both are separate from this state. | `character → strategy`: Each moving squad has one formal hero commander and up to 20 rank-and-file soldiers. Splitting and merging are allowed only when no battle or interception is occurring on the same floor and node, and only if the merged squad stays within the cap. If the commander is lost, the soldiers elect a temporary squad leader. The temporary leader issues the same orders, but with weaker effects. | `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:28`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:54`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:56`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:58`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:61`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:62` |
| house | Houses are the registry dimension of the units that hand down work and seats in the three factions: the Government's Assembly Member houses, the Free Cities' workbench houses (among them the seal houses that share a city's seal), and the Arc's Near Houses. There are no company groups and no numbered operating organizations. A house may hold a district (duchy) as its seat but never owns a whole faction. A rule for a house that dies out exists only for the Free Cities, provisionally (chapter 05 section 2.1 item 9, provisional T31-11); the rest is undecided. | `house → house`: Updated, and read-only projections regenerated, only when a house registration in the authoring canon (`data/sql`) is edited. No extinction or automatic faction-ownership transitions are added. | `docs/CANON-BIBLE.md` section 1 rows 7, 8, 12, `docs/design/v3/01-core.md` sections 7, 8, 10, `docs/design/v3/05-free-city.md` section 2.1 |
| strategy | Per-squad orders for an independent expedition → time-based movement (Decision 14); stances are normal march, forced march, ambush, garrison, and camp. | `strategy → engagement`: Movement occurs after the whole route passes the stance, terrain, transit-right, blockade, floor, and control-authority checks; on entering controlled territory the squad stops, and the next order is retreat, attack, or permit bypass. A forced march cannot initiate an attack or interception. Clashes and encounters are resolved deterministically for identical inputs. | `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:68`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:70`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:71`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:72`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:73`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:76`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:84`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:87`, `GDD/rules/Travel-and-Encounters.md:27` |
| engagement | Each squad's encounter branches into non-combat resolution (negotiation, stealth, detour, on-the-spot trade, etc.) or an engagement. On-the-spot trade is not the Trade ending. | `engagement → return`: Non-combat outcomes are applied to the ledger exactly once; `engagement → battle`: if it is an engagement, it is handed off to a closed context with participants, stances, floors, and reinforcement candidates fixed. | `GDD/rules/Travel-and-Encounters.md:29`, `GDD/rules/Travel-and-Encounters.md:31`, `GDD/rules/Travel-and-Encounters.md:33`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:78` |
| battle | Fixed context → a battle of pre-engagement unit orders and per-soldier resolution → one of: ordinary victory/defeat, ordered withdrawal, morale rout, or accepted surrender. Capture is a per-character outcome, not a terminal state. Battles have no pause (owner decision, 2026-09-24). | `battle → return`: The terminal result is issued under a `ResultId`. An ordered withdrawal requires a legal retreat path, and a surrender requires the opponent's acceptance. Confirmed replacement orders are applied in sequence at the next simulation step; other parties and the shared campaign are not halted. | `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:3`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:22`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:24`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:30`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:37`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:40`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:42`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:44`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:46` |
| return | The per-expedition result-settlement state is separate from the expedition-ending choice. After settlement is complete, the same expedition can continue without being ended. The five selectable endings are Return, Settlement, Conquest, Wandering, and Trade. | `return → strategy`: Atomically settle a verified result only once per `ResultId`, and after confirming the receipt, continue the same expedition; `return → Gwihwan/Jeongchak/Jeongbok/Bangnang/Gyoyeok` (return/settlement/conquest/wandering/trade): only when choosing the expedition's outcome. Redelivery of the same result returns the existing receipt; a different result for the same battle produces an error with no change. No automatic return. | `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:34`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:36`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:38`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:40`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:7`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:9`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:10`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:11`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:12`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:13`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:15` |
| atlas | The canon of world facts is the canon bible and the v3 chapters, and the authoring canon is `data/sql`. Wiki documents, illustrations, and house entries are read-only projections made from them. The old `WNA-001` World Narrative Atlas is not a v3 source. It is not runtime world state. | `atlas → house/ecology`: Registered content of the authoring canon is validated and projected as read-only. Projections are not edited directly, and registrations are not treated as runtime transitions. | `docs/CANON-BIBLE.md` section 1, `docs/design/v3/README.md`, `docs/design/v3/08-document-map.md` |
| places | Per-dong occupation markers: `held` (one faction's control is 50 or higher), `contested` (multiple factions, or one faction below 50), `vacant` (no faction flag); buildings and stations remain separate. Per-floor `flooded/sealed/occupied/abandoned/yard` is a separate dimension. | `places → places`: When a dong's occupation conditions change, those three states are re-evaluated. The minimum unit of conquest is a building; a dong flag alone does not capture a building. Station track connectivity and passability are not repurposed for this dong state, and dong adjacency is not turned into station travel edges. | `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:7`, `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:9`, `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:11`, `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:15`, `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:16`, `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:17`, `WEB/lore/places/Building-Reuse-Geography.md:74`, `GDD/rules/Travel-and-Encounters.md:23`, `GDD/rules/Travel-and-Encounters.md:25` |
| ecology | The hostile ecology groups `G01–G26` (animals G01-G06, hostile human groups G07-G12, old machines inside Seoul G13-G16 and G25, perimeter machines G17-G24 and G26) are a registry dimension. The old Atlas placement numbers (`M001–M039`) have no v3 source and are not used (provisional T21-sysdesign-2-1). Runtime habitat, encounter, and defeat states for ecology are undecided. | `ecology → ecology`: Apart from updating registered content of the authoring canon, there are no grounded runtime transitions. Codex entries are not used as grounds to create battle participation or defeat transitions. | `docs/design/v3/02-ecology.md` sections 1 and 4-6 |
| rules | The individually resolved combat contract for the current product goal follows the confirmed rules and content version. | `rules → strategy/battle/save`: Orders are validated, recorded, and replayed using the confirmed rules and content version. Command queues, slow-down, and fast-forward are not promoted to current goals. | `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:3`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:17`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:93`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:7`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:17` |
| save | The persistence dimension of the event ledger, versioned world state, in-progress battle checkpoints, and settlement receipts. Random-number streams for battles, encounters, and world events are kept separate. | `save → save`: A temporary file is written and checked, then swapped in atomically; restore/import happens only if signature, hash, version, and lineage checks pass. Corrupted or unsupported saves produce an explicit error and keep the existing backup; there is no silent recovery. It is not a substitute transition for settlement or return. | `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:3`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:7`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:11`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:23`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:25`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:54`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:56`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:15` |
| pov | The player's map viewpoint is fixed to the position and knowledge of one currently living character. Direct control and the authority layers of propose/approve/reject are separate, and battles neither duplicate this viewpoint nor halt the shared world. | `pov → pov`: Authority expands gradually only, from ordinary member → party commander → office holder → faction ruler. New remote dispatch is locked while captured, missing, or disconnected; after restoration or with a formally designated proxy, dispatch and resolution occur after re-evaluation within scope, and the POV is not transferred. | `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:7`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:8`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:9`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:10`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:15`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:16`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:35`, `GDD/system-design/campaign-pov-authority/README.md:38`, `GDD/rules/Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip.md:3` |

Rules for a house that dies out (outside the Free Cities) and runtime ecology transitions are undecided. Result settlement is internal to `return` and creates no new top-level id.

# 노드 상태

열두 id는 서로 다른 소유자의 상태와 기록을 구분하는 아키텍처 노드다. 인물·가문·장소·화면을 차례로 통과하는 전역 진행 단계가 아니다. 인물과 분대는 같은 세계 시간에서 각자의 행동을 진행하며, 명령이나 사건의 조건이 충족되면 해당 대상만 상태를 바꾼다. 생활 공간에서도 사건이 발생하고, 지도나 패널을 선택해도 관련 없는 대상의 행동은 계속된다. 각 행의 화살표는 그 대상의 합법적 상태 변경 또는 기록 간 연결을 뜻한다. 생활·전략 지도·전투는 표시하는 공간과 정보가 다른 화면이며 세계 진행을 소유하지 않는다. 이 표는 제품 목표의 설계 계약이며 구현 상태는 별도 검증 기록으로 확인한다. 표의 GDD 인용은 `bedb366d6eb1d884bce39f4dd3cf3ab9890b0403`, 장소 행의 옛 세계관 인용은 별도 저장소 `84040eb7124f4e6e779b42e7e3c091f71bbdbac8`의 고정 트리 행 번호다. 집안·총람·생태 행의 세계관 근거는 이 저장소의 정본 바이블(`docs/CANON-BIBLE.md`)과 v3 장(`docs/design/v3/`)의 절이다.

| id | 독립 상태 차원 | 합법적 나가는 전이·가드 | 근거 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| character | 영웅 편성 상태는 지휘관·배속·독립 요원·사용 불가 중 정확히 하나. 영웅마다 주 전투 클래스 하나와 보조 역할 태그를 두며(2026-09-24 소유자 결정) 여섯 클래스 이름은 아직 제안이다. 둘 다 이 상태와 별개다. | `character → strategy`: 이동 분대마다 정식 영웅 지휘관 한 명, 병졸 분대 최대 20명. 분리·합류는 같은 층·노드에서 전투·요격이 없고 합류 후 상한 이내일 때만 허용. 지휘관 상실 시 병졸 임시 분대장을 선출한다. 임시 분대장은 같은 명령을 내리되 효과가 약하다. | `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:28`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:54`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:56`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:58`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:61`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:62` |

| rules | 현재 제품 목표의 개인 판정 전투 계약은 확정된 규칙·콘텐츠 판본에 따른다. | `rules → strategy/battle/save`: 확정된 규칙·콘텐츠 판본으로 명령을 검증·기록하고 재생한다. 명령 큐·감속·배속을 현재 목표로 승격하지 않는다. | `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:3`, `GDD/rules/Personal-Resolution-Battle.md:17`, `GDD/rules/Hero-Squads-and-Time-Based-Movement.md:93`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:7`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:17` |
| save | 사건 원장과 판본 붙은 월드 상태·진행 중 전투 체크포인트·정산 영수증의 영속 차원. 전투·조우·세계 사건 난수 흐름을 분리한다. | `save → save`: 임시 파일 작성·검사 후 원자 교체, 서명·해시·판본·계보 검사 통과 시만 복원/반입. 손상·미지원 저장은 명시 오류와 기존 백업 보존; 조용한 복구 없음. 정산·귀환의 대용 전이가 아니다. | `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:3`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:7`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:11`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:23`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:25`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:54`, `GDD/rules/Save-and-Determinism.md:56`, `GDD/rules/Campaign-Loop.md:15` |

title: D16 Archpie — Full Logic of Diplomacy, War, Siege, and Captives
body_md:
# D16 Archpie — Full Logic of Diplomacy, War, Siege, and Captives

This page shows, as a structural diagram, the mechanical inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the diplomacy, war, siege, and captive domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map, and the approval status of numerical values follows the source contract.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D16","diagramId":"d16-flow","moduleTitle":"D16 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer Contract (ledger-with-optional-siege-or-escape-performance-contest): Preserve registered war-score channel caps and existing event weights; no d10 conversion. Supply/work and stage policies govern siege; 100 score or progress 1 never directly transfers property or creates casualties. Custody transition requires actual event/authority.

## Calculation and Output

```text
score-contribution [] battle: supplied signed delta subject to cumulative battle channel [-50,50]; enemy leader +100; primary/second/third designated heir +50/+25/+10; enemy capital +10
score-symmetry [] W_defender = -W_attacker
score-deduplication [] unique(warId,eventId,resultId); duplicate tuple is rejected before mutation
endpoint [] abs(W)=100 => terminal lock; revalidate casus belli; settle exactly one fixed terminal effect or invalidate without victory
reinforcement-admission [] arrived && battleStatus=ongoing => mayJoin; battleStatus=ended => cannotJoin
single-loss-settlement [] settlementKey=warId+sourceResultId+lossIdentity; apply at most once
treaty-stage-separation [] legalEffectReceipt != handoverReceipt; fulfillment requires all indivisible required clauses and their stage receipts
D16-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] battleAfter=clamp(battleBefore+suppliedBattleDelta,-50,50); effectiveBattleDelta=battleAfter-battleBefore; registered other deltas leader100,designatedHeirs50/25/10,capital10; Wafter=clamp(Wbefore+effectiveDelta,-100,100); opponent=-Wafter; abs(Wafter)==100 locks terminal then revalidates CB/beneficiary
D16-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] siegeProgressAfter=clamp(progress+siegeWork/requiredWork-repair,0,1); each stage requires independent policy and actual supply/access; reaching1 requests registered stage transition, not automatic casualties or ownership
D16-F3 [Candidate · Pre-approval] custodyAfter=registeredTransition(captiveEvent,actualLocation,currentCustodian,authority,requiredConsent); release/escape/transport never inferred from war score alone

```

The remaining contract leaves of D16 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operation flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not placed on the operation edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- warId/casusBelliId/rulesVersion — nonempty string (identity)
- attackerId/defenderId/beneficiaryId — stable entity identity (identity)
- scoreAttacker — integer (war-score point)
- eventId/resultId — nonempty stable identity (identity)
- scoreEvent.kind — battle|enemyLeaderCaptured|primaryHeirCaptured|secondHeirCaptured|thirdHeirCaptured|enemyCapitalOccupied (enum)
- battleDelta — integer when kind=battle (war-score point)
- battleChannelTotal — integer (war-score point)
- casusBelliValid/declarationAuthority — boolean with current revision evidence (predicate)
- battleStatus/arrivalAt/battleEndedAt — ongoing|ended and ordered clock coordinates (D18 supplied world-clock coordinate)
- organizationLifecycleClauseId — registered clause identity (identity)
- treatyClauseId/legalEffectReceipt/handoverReceipt — separate identities (identity)
- bodyStateId/bodyRevision/effectId — approved identity and revision (identity/revision)

The data owner is rules: GDD D16 integration wave; world facts: WIKI/LORE authoring owners; rights and titles: D10/D11; battle results: D15; prices and signatures: D17; same-boundary ordering: D18, and the maintained contracts are score-contribution, score-symmetry, score-deduplication, endpoint, reinforcement-admission, single-loss-settlement, and treaty-stage-separation. The state ownership boundaries are war/CB/fixed beneficiary, score W, battle channel, processed tuple, terminal receipt, siege stages/work/supply, and actual captive location/custodian. Commit rule: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
- Existing evaluator errors: E_UNIT, E_SCORE, E_FIELDS, E_REPLAY, E_BATTLE_CAP, E_EVENT_KIND, E_ENDPOINT, E_UNKNOWN, E_HELD_INPUT, E_CUSTODY_POLICY_HELD
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limit: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. The next implementation unit is U-D16-war-score-siege-custody (TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/war-score-siege-custody.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/war-score-siege-custody.test.mjs). Separate from the approval of character and world values, this archpie shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- War and Party Versions — [Declaration · Fixed Purpose] Read the exact war, casus belli, attacker, defender, beneficiary, and rule version, and reject missing targets and stale versions. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.decl​areWar[0]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.decl​areWar[1]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.decl​areWar[2]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.decl​areWar[3]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.decl​areWar[4]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.decl​areWar[5])
- Grounds and Declaration Authority — [Declaration · Fixed Purpose] Require both a currently valid registered CB and independent declaration authority. Holding a justification alone does not grant military or propaganda authority. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail entries)
- Fix Objective, Beneficiary, and Terminal Effects — [Declaration · Fixed Purpose] After fixing the target, objective, beneficiary, and the four terminal effects, create a single declaration receipt. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail entries)
- Confirm Score Event — [War Score Channel] Reject terminated, invalidated, stale-version, and duplicate event/result entries, and confirm that the event type corresponds to the actual role. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[0]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[1]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[2]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[3]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[4]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[5]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.appl​yScoreEvent[6])
- Cumulative Battle ±50 — [War Score Channel] Read the actual D15 result. The existing evaluator rejects with E_BATTLE_CAP if the absolute value of the cumulative battle channel exceeds 50. The matrix saturation calculation and the conflict are left as separate open issues. (Source: d16.b9.formulaSheet[0].e​xpression; d16.b9.formulaSheet[0].r​ounding; d16.b9.formulaSheet[0].c​lamp; d16.b9.formulaSheet[0].r​ng; d16.b9.formulaSheet[0].a​uthority)
- Fixed Event Scores — [War Score Channel] Capturing the enemy leader is +100, the designated heirs ranked 1st/2nd/3rd are +50/+25/+10, and occupying the enemy capital is +10. These existing constants are not recalculated from d10 results. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail entries)
- Total Score & Symmetry — [War Score Channel] Only the total W, which adds the permitted contributions, is clamped to [-100,100]. The defender's score is the negative of the attacker's score. (Source: d16.b9.formulaSheet[1].e​xpression; d16.b9.formulaSheet[1].r​ounding; d16.b9.formulaSheet[1].c​lamp; d16.b9.formulaSheet[1].r​ng; d16.b9.formulaSheet[1].a​uthority)
- Exact ±100 Lock — [War Score Channel] If the absolute value is exactly 100, a settlement lock is applied and the cause and beneficiary are rechecked. No further score accumulates and no demands are added. (Source: d16.b9.formulaSheet[3].e​xpression; d16.b9.formulaSheet[3].r​ounding; d16.b9.formulaSheet[3].c​lamp; d16.b9.formulaSheet[3].r​ng; d16.b9.formulaSheet[3].a​uthority)
- Input and Demand Lock — [Settlement Revalidation] Fixes the settlement inputs and stops the accumulation of score and new demands. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.sett​leEndpoint[0])
- Fixed Beneficiary Recheck — [Settlement Revalidation] Rechecks the cause and beneficiary fixed at the outbreak of war, along with their current eligibility. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.sett​leEndpoint[1])
- Invalidation Without Victory — [Settlement Revalidation] If the cause is invalid, only the registration invalidation effect is processed. There is no automatic attacker benefit and no creation of rights without a basis. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.sett​leEndpoint[2])
- Fixed Victory and Defeat Effects — [Settlement Revalidation] Only when the cause remains valid are victory and defeat effects requested within the fixed scope of the objective. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.sett​leEndpoint[3])
- Single Settlement Result — [Settlement Revalidation] After occupation, rights, ratification, recovery, prisoners, and handover are recorded in separate ledgers, a single settlement ResultId is applied. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.sett​leEndpoint[5])
- Per-Stage Treaty Receipts — [Treaties, Prisoners, Organizations, Reinforcements] Acceptance, signing, legal effect, and physical handover are separate. Every indivisible mandatory clause must have a stage receipt to be fulfilled. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.trea​tyExecution[0]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.trea​tyExecution[1]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.trea​tyExecution[2]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.trea​tyExecution[3]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.trea​tyExecution[4])
- Actual Reinforcement Participation — [Treaties, Prisoners, Organizations, Reinforcements] If reinforcements actually arrive at an ongoing battle, they participate from that point on; if the battle has ended, they are rejected. Participation does not create command, siege, prisoners, or score. (Source: d16.b9.orderedSteps.rein​forceBattle[0]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.rein​forceBattle[1]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.rein​forceBattle[2]; d16.b9.orderedSteps.rein​forceBattle[3])
- Single Prisoner Identity — [Treaties, Prisoners, Organizations, Reinforcements] Maintains one identity per person and one actual custody state. The exact transitions for release, recapture, escape, ransom, and multi-war linkage are undecided. (Source: d16.b9.lifecycle.captivi​ty)
- Organizational Continuity — [Treaties, Prisoners, Organizations, Reinforcements] Loss of territory or a leader alone does not delete the organization, its property, or its debts. An actual representative, administrator, and dissolution clause are required as separate inputs. (Source: d16.b11.authority.sealed​RowsApplied[1].effect)
- One-Time Health Loss — [Treaties, Prisoners, Organizations, Reinforcements] The same derived loss with the same warId+sourceResultId+los​sIdentity is not settled twice. Battle damage is not automatically converted into war score. (Source: d16.b9.formulaSheet[5].e​xpression; d16.b9.formulaSheet[5].r​ounding; d16.b9.formulaSheet[5].c​lamp; d16.b9.formulaSheet[5].r​ng; d16.b9.formulaSheet[5].a​uthority)

# D16 아치파이 — 외교·전쟁·공성·포로 전체 논리

이 페이지는 외교·전쟁·공성·포로 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D16","diagramId":"d16-flow","moduleTitle":"D16 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(ledger-with-optional-siege-or-escape-performance-contest): Preserve registered war-score channel caps and existing event weights; no d10 conversion. Supply/work and stage policies govern siege; 100 score or progress 1 never directly transfers property or creates casualties. Custody transition requires actual event/authority.

## 계산과 출력

```text
score-contribution [] battle: supplied signed delta subject to cumulative battle channel [-50,50]; enemy leader +100; primary/second/third designated heir +50/+25/+10; enemy capital +10
score-symmetry [] W_defender = -W_attacker
score-deduplication [] unique(warId,eventId,resultId); duplicate tuple is rejected before mutation
endpoint [] abs(W)=100 => terminal lock; revalidate casus belli; settle exactly one fixed terminal effect or invalidate without victory
reinforcement-admission [] arrived && battleStatus=ongoing => mayJoin; battleStatus=ended => cannotJoin
single-loss-settlement [] settlementKey=warId+sourceResultId+lossIdentity; apply at most once
treaty-stage-separation [] legalEffectReceipt != handoverReceipt; fulfillment requires all indivisible required clauses and their stage receipts
D16-F1 [후보·승인 전] battleAfter=clamp(battleBefore+suppliedBattleDelta,-50,50); effectiveBattleDelta=battleAfter-battleBefore; registered other deltas leader100,designatedHeirs50/25/10,capital10; Wafter=clamp(Wbefore+effectiveDelta,-100,100); opponent=-Wafter; abs(Wafter)==100 locks terminal then revalidates CB/beneficiary
D16-F2 [후보·승인 전] siegeProgressAfter=clamp(progress+siegeWork/requiredWork-repair,0,1); each stage requires independent policy and actual supply/access; reaching1 requests registered stage transition, not automatic casualties or ownership
D16-F3 [후보·승인 전] custodyAfter=registeredTransition(captiveEvent,actualLocation,currentCustodian,authority,requiredConsent); release/escape/transport never inferred from war score alone

```

D16의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- warId/casusBelliId/rulesVersion — nonempty string (identity)
- attackerId/defenderId/beneficiaryId — stable entity identity (identity)
- scoreAttacker — integer (war-score point)
- eventId/resultId — nonempty stable identity (identity)
- scoreEvent.kind — battle|enemyLeaderCaptured|primaryHeirCaptured|secondHeirCaptured|thirdHeirCaptured|enemyCapitalOccupied (enum)
- battleDelta — integer when kind=battle (war-score point)
- battleChannelTotal — integer (war-score point)
- casusBelliValid/declarationAuthority — boolean with current revision evidence (predicate)
- battleStatus/arrivalAt/battleEndedAt — ongoing|ended and ordered clock coordinates (D18 supplied world-clock coordinate)
- organizationLifecycleClauseId — registered clause identity (identity)
- treatyClauseId/legalEffectReceipt/handoverReceipt — separate identities (identity)
- bodyStateId/bodyRevision/effectId — approved identity and revision (identity/revision)

자료 소유자는 규칙 GDD D16 integration wave; 세계 사실 WIKI/LORE authoring owners; 권리·작위 D10/D11; 전투 결과 D15; 가격·서명 D17; 같은 경계 순서 D18, 유지 계약은 score-contribution·score-symmetry·score-deduplication·endpoint·reinforcement-admission·single-loss-settlement·treaty-stage-separation다. 상태 소유 경계는 war/CB/fixed beneficiary,score W,battle channel,processed tuple,terminal receipt,siege stages/work/supply,actual captive location/custodian. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_UNIT, E_SCORE, E_FIELDS, E_REPLAY, E_BATTLE_CAP, E_EVENT_KIND, E_ENDPOINT, E_UNKNOWN, E_HELD_INPUT, E_CUSTODY_POLICY_HELD
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D16-war-score-siege-custody(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/war-score-siege-custody.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/war-score-siege-custody.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

title: D17 Archpie — Complete Logic of Negotiation, Trade, Peace, and Contracts
body_md:
# D17 Archpie — Complete Logic of Negotiation, Trade, Peace, and Contracts

This page shows, as a structural diagram, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and conservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the negotiation, trade, peace, and contract domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contracts and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the approval status of numeric values follows the source contract.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D17","diagramId":"d17-flow","moduleTitle":"D17 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (authority-and-conservation-with-optional-dialogue-contest): Same-unit demand minus offer, separate assent by required parties, repricing requires new acceptance; delivered+remaining conserved. Dialogue win may improve conveyed proposal evidence only, not assent.

## Calculation and Output

```text
demandSum [] sum(term.price.amount for eligible demand terms)
offerSum [] sum(term.price.amount for eligible offer terms)
proposalValue [] V=demandSum-offerSum
quantityConservation [] delivered_after + remaining_after = delivered_before + remaining_before for each signed term unless a separately supplied lawful quantity-changing event exists
revision [] accepted new event: ledger version +1; duplicate/reject: unchanged
D17-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] value=sum(eligible demand prices)-sum(eligible offer prices); value<=warScore never implies acceptance; deliveredAfter+remainingAfter=deliveredBefore+remainingBefore unless separately lawful quantity-changing event
D17-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] utility=sum(w_j*u_j(knownSnapshot)); registeredResponsePolicy may propose response; explicit required party consent/signature remains separate; no raw values-cast weight reuse

```

The remaining contract leaves of D17 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operation flow. Historical reference formulas and undetermined values are not placed on operation edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- version — safe nonnegative integer (ledger revision)
- war — WarSnapshot (war ID/score/casus-belli/endpoint status)
- proposal — Proposal | null (stable proposal ID and revision)
- terms — Term[] (one demand or offer per stable term ID)
- rights — RightSnapshot[] (stable right/asset/person/obligation ID)
- contracts — DeliveryContract[] (signed term obligation)
- history — event ID -> payload digest and receipt (event identity)

The data owner is the D17 negotiation and settlement ledger, and the maintained contracts are demandSum·offerSum·proposalValue·quantityConservation·revision. The state ownership boundary is terms and same-unit prices,proposal revision/snapshot,signers/fresh acceptances,reservations,contract delivered/remaining,cancellation/expiry/death evidence. Commit rule: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_REVISION, E_CONSERVATION
- Existing evaluator errors: E_TYPE, E_SCHEMA, E_VERSION, E_ID, E_CONSERVATION, E_PLEDGE, E_AUTHORITY, E_RIGHT, E_CONSENT, E_FEASIBILITY
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limit: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. # D17 아치파이 — 협상·거래·강화·계약 전체 논리

이 페이지는 협상·거래·강화·계약 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D17","diagramId":"d17-flow","moduleTitle":"D17 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(authority-and-conservation-with-optional-dialogue-contest): Same-unit demand minus offer, separate assent by required parties, repricing requires new acceptance; delivered+remaining conserved. Dialogue win may improve conveyed proposal evidence only, not assent.

## 계산과 출력

```text
demandSum [] sum(term.price.amount for eligible demand terms)
offerSum [] sum(term.price.amount for eligible offer terms)
proposalValue [] V=demandSum-offerSum
quantityConservation [] delivered_after + remaining_after = delivered_before + remaining_before for each signed term unless a separately supplied lawful quantity-changing event exists
revision [] accepted new event: ledger version +1; duplicate/reject: unchanged
D17-F1 [후보·승인 전] value=sum(eligible demand prices)-sum(eligible offer prices); value<=warScore never implies acceptance; deliveredAfter+remainingAfter=deliveredBefore+remainingBefore unless separately lawful quantity-changing event
D17-F2 [후보·승인 전] utility=sum(w_j*u_j(knownSnapshot)); registeredResponsePolicy may propose response; explicit required party consent/signature remains separate; no raw values-cast weight reuse

```

D17의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- version — safe nonnegative integer (ledger revision)
- war — WarSnapshot (war ID/score/casus-belli/endpoint status)
- proposal — Proposal | null (stable proposal ID and revision)
- terms — Term[] (one demand or offer per stable term ID)
- rights — RightSnapshot[] (stable right/asset/person/obligation ID)
- contracts — DeliveryContract[] (signed term obligation)
- history — event ID -> payload digest and receipt (event identity)

자료 소유자는 D17 negotiation and settlement ledger, 유지 계약은 demandSum·offerSum·proposalValue·quantityConservation·revision다. 상태 소유 경계는 terms and same-unit prices,proposal revision/snapshot,signers/fresh acceptances,reservations,contract delivered/remaining,cancellation/expiry/death evidence. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_REVISION, E_CONSERVATION
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_SCHEMA, E_VERSION, E_ID, E_CONSERVATION, E_PLEDGE, E_AUTHORITY, E_RIGHT, E_CONSENT, E_FEASIBILITY
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D17-proposal-assent-delivery(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/proposal-assent-delivery.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/proposal-assent-delivery.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 협상 가능한 경계 — [항목별 협상 적격] D16가 서명 전에 |W|=100을 제공하면 열린 제안을 폐기하고 고정 CB 종결만 따른다. 새로운 동시 사건 우선순위는 D18 입력이다. (원문: d17.b11.mechanisms[4].al​gorithm)
- 당사자·항목 조건 — [항목별 협상 적격] 서명권과 처분권을 따로 검사하고 항목 ID·요구/제공·수혜자·강제 범위·제삼자 권리·필요 동의·실행 가능성·중복 담보를 모두 확인한다. (원문: d17.b11.mechanisms[0].al​gorithm)
- 등록 가격·동일 단위 — [항목별 협상 적격] 모든 항목에 현재 제안 스냅샷과 판본이 결속된 등록 가격이 있어야 한다. 누락 가격은 0이 아니며 미정이다. (원문: d17.b11.mechanisms[1].al​gorithm)
- 요구합－제공합 — [항목별 협상 적격] 같은 가격 단위에서 demandSum-offerSum을 정확하게 계산한다. 물품 수량의 이종 단위를 합산하지 않는다. (원문: d17.b9.formulaSheet[2].e​xpression; d17.b9.formulaSheet[2].u​nit; d17.b9.formulaSheet[2].n​ull; d17.b9.formulaSheet[2].c​lamp; d17.b9.formulaSheet[2].r​ounding; d17.b9.formulaSheet[2].r​ng)
- 명시 응답 — [수락·거절·역제안] 권한 있는 당사자의 수락은 제안 개정·스냅샷 digest에 결속된다. 거절·역제안은 별도 분기이며 V<=W·호감·신뢰·대화 승리로 수락을 만들지 않는다. (원문: d17.b11.mechanisms[2].al​gorithm)
- 명시 재가격 — [수락·거절·역제안] 관련 상태가 바뀌면 같은 제안 신원에 새 개정·스냅샷을 만들고 모든 과거 수락을 무효화한다. (원문: d17.b11.mechanisms[3].al​gorithm)
- 새 수락·항목 재검사 — [수락·거절·역제안] 새 가격·권한·제삼자 권리·동의·가능성·예약을 수락/서명에서 재검사하고 새 영수증을 요구한다. 기존 참조 평가기는 재가격 즉시 항목 재검사를 하지 않으므로 그 차이를 미검증으로 남긴다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 서명 시 재검사 — [단일 서명·분할 이행] 현재 유효한 수락 스냅샷에서 권한·항목 적격·가격·배타 예약을 다시 검사한다. (원문: d17.b9.commitPoint)
- 정산 ID 하나 — [단일 서명·분할 이행] 유효 예약을 원자 획득하고 정산 ID 하나와 조항별 인도 의무를 만든다. 물품·인격체를 순간이동하거나 복제하지 않는다. (원문: d17.b11.mechanisms[5].al​gorithm)

title: D18 Achipai — Complete Logic of Time, Events, and Storage
body_md:
# D18 Achipai — Complete Logic of Time, Events, and Storage

This page shows the mechanical inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the time, event, and storage domain as a structure diagram. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; numeric approval status follows the source contract.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D18","diagramId":"d18-flow","moduleTitle":"D18 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (ordering-replay-and-conservation-no-roll): Preserve accepted ingress order; unresolved new causality holds that event, not world. Replays no new draws/effects; atomically retain receipts/reservations/residuals/knowledge. No invented tick rate or PRNG.

## Calculation and Output

```text
same-time-comparator [] independentSatisfiedProposals sorted by stored ingressOrdinal ascending
next-due [] min(valid supplied dueTicks >= worldTick); empty => NO_WORK
goal-boundary [] -100 <= W <= 100; opponent=-W; abs(W)=100 => revalidate fixed CB/beneficiary then immediate registered goal effect or registered invalidation
cutoff [] verifiedArrivalTick <= cutoffTick
receipt-count [] after receipt count = before + 1 for new committed ResultId; replay count unchanged
D18-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] nextDue=min(valid supplied due>=worldTick); empty=>NO_WORK; independent already-satisfied proposals preserve durable ingressOrdinal; ambiguous new causality=>held
D18-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] new committed receiptCount=before+1; exact replay unchanged; arrivalAt<=cutoff only approved cargo cutoff scope
D18-F3 [Candidate · Pre-approval] checkpoint binds rulesVersion,architecture,sourceRefs,all open phases,consumed,reserved,progress,residual,knowledge,draw results and accepted prefix; validate temporary candidate before replacing live state

```

The remaining contract leaves of D18 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operation flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not placed on operation edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- worldTick — integer (campaignTick)
- ingressOrdinal — integer (admissionOrdinal)
- eventId/resultId/causeId/actorId/targetId — stable-id (identity)
- expectedRevision — integer (revision)
- pendingResidual — exact-value (campaignTick fraction)
- warScore — number (score)
- effectPayload — owner-domain-state-change (owner-defined)
- drawAddress — tuple (identity)

The data owner is rules: GDD; authored facts: WIKI read-only; campaign: single-campaign state; presentation: current-body knowledge/access projection only, and the maintained contracts are same-time-comparator, next-due, goal-boundary, cutoff, and receipt-count. State ownership boundaries: project Tick/clockVersion,accepted ingress,causal graph,pending/residual/reservations,source variants,knowledge,draw addresses/cursors,receipts/checkpoint versions. Commit rules: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_REVISION, E_PRECISION, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
- Existing evaluator errors: E_TYPE, E_UNIT, E_TIME, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT, E_COMMIT, E_VERSION, E_CHECKSUM, E_TRUNCATED
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limit: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. The next implementation unit is U-D18-existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter (TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter.test.mjs). Separate from the approval of character and world values, this Achipai shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Valid next time — [Next Event · Existing Ingress Order] Read the minimum of the valid supplied dueTicks that are at or after the current worldTick. Do not create second conversions, tick quanta, or new turns. (Source: d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].e​xpression; d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].u​nit; d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].a​uthority; d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].l​imit)
- No work — [Next Event · Existing Ingress Order] If there are no valid supplied candidates, the result is NO_WORK. Do not turn this into a time stop or the creation of a new event. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Independent ingress order — [Next Event · Existing Ingress Order] Process only independent proposals at the same time whose causes are already satisfied, in ascending order of stored ingressOrdinal. Do not change the order already accepted. (Source: d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].e​xpression; d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].u​nit; d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].a​uthority; d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].l​imit)
- New causality undetermined — [Next Event · Existing Ingress Order] Ambiguous causality that has not yet been accepted holds that event. Do not invent a global priority among death, arrival, confirmation, and conclusion, and do not halt the world. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[2].d​etail)
- Limited order at the cargo boundary — [Next Event · Existing Ingress Order] Verified arrival <= consumption boundary is included in the same boundary. Placing arrival verification ahead of reservation, production, and consumption at the same time applies only within the approved cargo scope. (Source: d18.b11.sourceClaims[12]​.rule)
- Event and result identity — [Duplicates · Address · Atomic Commit] The same event, result, and address with an identical payload returns the existing result, while a changed payload is explicitly rejected. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[4].d​etail)
- Replay of existing result — [Duplicates · Address · Atomic Commit] A replay is not a new receipt, effect, or random draw. The receipt count stays the same. (Source: d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].e​xpression; d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].u​nit; d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].a​uthority; d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].l​imit)
- Recheck of latest owner ledger — [Duplicates · Address · Atomic Commit] Recheck the exact expectedRevision and the current authority, CB, beneficiary, and eligibility at the actual time of execution. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[3].d​etail)
- Recorded random-draw address — [Duplicates · Address · Atomic Commit] A recorded address with the same purpose, person, state, event, and label returns the recorded value. A new draw is held unless there is an existing adapter that is legitimately bound, and no arbitrary PRNG is chosen. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[5].d​etail)
- State, result, and receipt together — [Duplicates · Address · Atomic Commit] Apply the owner ledger effect, ResultId, receipt, and acce​ptedPrefix all together. A +0 counter alone does not substitute for actual restoration or settlement. (Source: d18.b9.fields[0].snapsho​t.commitPoint)
- Completion boundary — [Save · Restore at Completion Boundary] Save only at a boundary where acceptance and result application are complete. Open commands, education, cargo, succession, and wars are kept at exactly the saved phase. (Source: d18.b11.sourceClaims[8].​rule)
- Full candidate validation — [Save · Restore at Completion Boundary] Collect all independent errors in format, unit, schema/rules/conte​nt version, checksum, completeness, and completion boundary. Do not truncate the error list to 10. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[0].d​etail)
- Preserve the status quo on failure — [Save · Restore at Completion Boundary] If there is even one error, preserve the live state and the previous backup. Do not start automatic repair, implicit migration, or a substitute campaign. (Source: d18.b9.lifecycle.load)
- Exact Stage Restoration — [Save/Restore at Completion Boundary] Replace only verified candidates. Exactly restore consumption amounts, progress, reservations, remaining quantities, results, random-number context, and intake prefix, and do not reapply ResultId. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[7].d​etail)
- Separation of World and Knowledge — [Save/Restore at Completion Boundary] World facts and each character's knowledge, report sources, and observation times are stored separately. Saving or loading itself is neither a new access right nor a world death event. (Source: d18.b9.orderedSteps[8].d​etail)
- Current Main Body Public Projection — [Save/Restore at Completion Boundary] Display only information that the current main body knows and can access. Do not leak hidden causes or exact internal results through public errors. (Source: d18.b11.sourceClaims[9].​rule)
- Exact Input and Units — Validates required keys, types, permanent IDs, and units. Distinguishes unconfirmed input from malformed format. # D18 아치파이 — 시간·사건·저장 전체 논리

이 페이지는 시간·사건·저장 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D18","diagramId":"d18-flow","moduleTitle":"D18 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(ordering-replay-and-conservation-no-roll): Preserve accepted ingress order; unresolved new causality holds that event, not world. Replays no new draws/effects; atomically retain receipts/reservations/residuals/knowledge. No invented tick rate or PRNG.

## 계산과 출력

```text
same-time-comparator [] independentSatisfiedProposals sorted by stored ingressOrdinal ascending
next-due [] min(valid supplied dueTicks >= worldTick); empty => NO_WORK
goal-boundary [] -100 <= W <= 100; opponent=-W; abs(W)=100 => revalidate fixed CB/beneficiary then immediate registered goal effect or registered invalidation
cutoff [] verifiedArrivalTick <= cutoffTick
receipt-count [] after receipt count = before + 1 for new committed ResultId; replay count unchanged
D18-F1 [후보·승인 전] nextDue=min(valid supplied due>=worldTick); empty=>NO_WORK; independent already-satisfied proposals preserve durable ingressOrdinal; ambiguous new causality=>held
D18-F2 [후보·승인 전] new committed receiptCount=before+1; exact replay unchanged; arrivalAt<=cutoff only approved cargo cutoff scope
D18-F3 [후보·승인 전] checkpoint binds rulesVersion,architecture,sourceRefs,all open phases,consumed,reserved,progress,residual,knowledge,draw results and accepted prefix; validate temporary candidate before replacing live state

```

D18의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- worldTick — integer (campaignTick)
- ingressOrdinal — integer (admissionOrdinal)
- eventId/resultId/causeId/actorId/targetId — stable-id (identity)
- expectedRevision — integer (revision)
- pendingResidual — exact-value (campaignTick fraction)
- warScore — number (score)
- effectPayload — owner-domain-state-change (owner-defined)
- drawAddress — tuple (identity)

자료 소유자는 규칙 GDD; 저작 사실 WIKI read-only; 캠페인 single-campaign state; 표현 current-body knowledge/access projection only, 유지 계약은 same-time-comparator·next-due·goal-boundary·cutoff·receipt-count다. 상태 소유 경계는 project Tick/clockVersion,accepted ingress,causal graph,pending/residual/reservations,source variants,knowledge,draw addresses/cursors,receipts/checkpoint versions. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_REVISION, E_PRECISION, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_UNIT, E_TIME, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT, E_COMMIT, E_VERSION, E_CHECKSUM, E_TRUNCATED
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D18-existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 유효 다음 시각 — [다음 사건·기존 접수 순서] 현재 worldTick 이상인 유효 공급 dueTicks의 최솟값을 읽는다. 초 환산·tick 양자·새 턴을 만들지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].e​xpression; d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].u​nit; d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].a​uthority; d18.b9.formulaSheet[1].l​imit)
- 작업 없음 — [다음 사건·기존 접수 순서] 유효 공급 후보가 비면 NO_WORK다. 시간 정지나 새 사건 생성으로 바꾸지 않는다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 독립 접수 순서 — [다음 사건·기존 접수 순서] 같은 시각의 원인이 이미 충족된 독립 제안만 저장 ingressOrdinal 오름차순으로 처리한다. 이미 접수된 순서를 바꾸지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].e​xpression; d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].u​nit; d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].a​uthority; d18.b9.formulaSheet[0].l​imit)
- 신규 인과 미정 — [다음 사건·기존 접수 순서] 아직 접수되지 않은 모호한 인과는 해당 사건을 보류한다. 사망·도착·인준·종결의 전역 우선순위를 지어내거나 세계를 정지하지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[2].d​etail)
- 화물 경계의 한정 순서 — [다음 사건·기존 접수 순서] 검증 도착<=소비 경계는 같은 경계에 포함된다. 같은 시각에 도착 검증을 예약·생산·소비보다 앞세우는 것은 승인 화물 범위에만 해당한다. (원문: d18.b11.sourceClaims[12]​.rule)
- 사건·결과 신원 — [중복·주소·원자 반영] 같은 사건·결과·주소와 동일 payload는 기존 결과를 반환하고 바뀐 payload는 명시 거부한다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[4].d​etail)
- 기존 결과 재생 — [중복·주소·원자 반영] 재생은 새 영수증·효과·난수 소비가 아니다. 영수증 수는 그대로다. (원문: d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].e​xpression; d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].u​nit; d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].a​uthority; d18.b9.formulaSheet[4].l​imit)
- 최신 소유 원장 재검사 — [중복·주소·원자 반영] 정확한 expectedRevision과 현재 권한·CB·수혜자·자격을 실제 실행 시점에 재검사한다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[3].d​etail)
- 기록된 난수 주소 — [중복·주소·원자 반영] 목적·인물·상태·사건·라벨이 같은 기록 주소는 기록 값을 반환한다. 새 추출은 적법하게 결속된 기존 어댑터 없이는 보류하고 임의 PRNG를 선택하지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[5].d​etail)
- 상태·결과·영수증 동시 — [중복·주소·원자 반영] 소유 원장 효과·ResultId·receipt·acce​ptedPrefix를 모두 함께 반영한다. +0 카운터만으로 실제 복원·정산을 대신하지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.fields[0].snapsho​t.commitPoint)
- 완료 경계 — [완료 경계 저장·복원] 수락과 결과 적용이 완료된 경계에서만 저장한다. 열린 명령·교육·화물·승계·전쟁은 정확히 저장된 단계로 유지한다. (원문: d18.b11.sourceClaims[8].​rule)
- 후보 전체 검증 — [완료 경계 저장·복원] 형식·단위·schema/rules/conte​nt 판본·checksum·완전성·완료 경계의 독립 오류를 모두 수집한다. 오류 목록을 10개로 자르지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[0].d​etail)
- 실패 시 현상 보존 — [완료 경계 저장·복원] 한 오류라도 있으면 live state와 이전 backup을 보존한다. 자동 수리·묵시 migration·대체 캠페인을 시작하지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.lifecycle.load)
- 정확 단계 복원 — [완료 경계 저장·복원] 검증된 후보만 교체한다. 소비량·진척·예약·잔량·결과·난수 문맥·접수 prefix를 정확히 복원하며 ResultId를 다시 적용하지 않는다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[7].d​etail)
- 세계와 지식 분리 — [완료 경계 저장·복원] 세계 사실과 인물별 지식·보고 출처·관측 시각은 각각 저장한다. 저장 또는 불러오기 자체는 새 접근권이나 세계 사망 사건이 아니다. (원문: d18.b9.orderedSteps[8].d​etail)
- 현재 본체 공개 투영 — [완료 경계 저장·복원] 현재 본체가 알고 접근 가능한 정보만 표시한다. 숨겨진 원인이나 정확한 내부 결과를 공개 오류로 누설하지 않는다. (원문: d18.b11.sourceClaims[9].​rule)
- 정확 입력·단위 — 필수 키·타입·영구 ID·단위를 검증한다. 미확인 입력과 잘못된 형식을 구분한다.
