title: Character Sheet and Domain Calculation Contract
body_md:
# Character Sheet and Domain Calculation Contract

Status: Proposed. This distinguishes approved rules, selected policies, unadopted alternatives, and undecided values. It does not mean implementation is complete.

Character contract as of 2026-10-12: Leadership, Strategy, Negotiation, Administration, Insight, Learning, Skill, and Stamina have a base integer range of 0–20 and a final integer range of 0–100. A base of 10 means a practitioner proficient in that field, and the final value after applying all traits, items, and statuses never exceeds 100. Opening effects with a narrative basis may allow a final value above 20. Action proficiency is 0–99.9, separate from competence, and is not counted twice with Skill. Traits affect performance, actions, stress, and relationships, and are acquired through events and actions. The body records the damage level and functional state of the left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head, and torso, along with separate disease progression, and combat and plague use the same body record. The resolution formula, effect composition, proficiency growth formula, individual effect magnitudes, trait list, and damage and function vocabulary are undecided. The GURPS CP, ST/DX/IQ/HT, HP/FP, and cost tables below, along with the 2026-10-08 opposed d10, 0–12 Skill, trait categories, and validation cases, apply only to explicitly past or research editions and are not required inputs, formulas, or implementation evidence for the new profile. There is no automatic conversion and no zero-filling of unconfirmed values. A public profile selects only approved public fields and does not include private motives or assignment ledgers.

[Design Guide](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [18 Situations](/gdd/system-design/domain-situations/)

This document connects a character's basic record, the source-work calculation notation confirmed directly, and the state rules approved in Seoul. It does not extend one character's record into a calculation formula for population, authority, logistics, or combat as a whole. Values and examples are calculated only when their inputs are known; undecided inputs remain undecided rather than becoming 0. It does not mean implementation is complete or that all rules have been adopted.

## Five Categories of Evidence

- Source reference: This is notation read directly from the 20-page preview of GURPS Basic Set: Characters Fourth Edition, Version 10.0 – March 2024. PDF pages 18–19 are the blank character sheets on printed pages 335–336. PDF pages 10–11 are the introduction and general conventions on printed pages 8–9. Blank fields, the table of contents, and the index do not substitute for missing rule text.
- Seoul approval: Population representation preservation, semi-open reservation, inclusive cutoff for verified arrivals, directional trust classification, per-item negotiation value structure, war score endpoints, and single termination retain only the scope that has already been approved.
- Selected policy: Cargo splitting retires the parent identity into history and divides the material into two children; the acquisition basis actually selected is the recipient's confirmation signature. The two-sided condition that adds confirmation by the current custodian is an unadopted engineering proposal in the case below and is not certified as the selected policy. When a negotiation reassessment is carried out with explicit authority and a new version/state snapshot, and an actual invalidation event is recorded, the old acceptance is invalidated. Related state changes or pending requests alone are not treated as invalidation. This selection is not approval of the overall logistics and negotiation rules or of the price and acceptance formulas.
- Proposal: The normalized data types, maximum/current value names, and domain sheet structure here are an original record model. Do not copy the original form's images. Distinguish approved state semantics from data type proposals.
- Missing rules: Ability costs, basic derived formulas, skill costs and defaults, the ST damage table, basic defense formulas, protection/injury/lethality outcomes, the full range and hit location tables, Seoul coefficients, and faction systems are undecided.

## Separate fields of the historical/original-reference character sheet

### Personal Identity

Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 identity; stable ID from D01.

- characterId: string; unit: identifier.
- name: string; unit: text.
- player: string; unit: text.
- height: number; unit: unspecified-on-sheet.
- bodyWeight: number; unit: unspecified-on-sheet.
- sizeModifier: integer; unit: modifier.
- age: number; unit: unspecified-on-sheet.
- appearance: string; unit: text.
- notes: string; unit: text.

### Primary Attributes

For historical/original research scope only; not a required input of the current profile. Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 primary attributes.

- ST: integer; unit: attribute-level.
- STCP: number; unit: CP.
- DX: integer; unit: attribute-level.
- DXCP: number; unit: CP.
- IQ: integer; unit: attribute-level.
- IQCP: number; unit: CP.
- HT: integer; unit: attribute-level.
- HTCP: number; unit: CP.

### Current Health and Baselines

For historical/original research scope only; not a required input of the current profile. Owner: D02. Basis: PDF18/B335 HP/FP CURRENT; D02 separation.

- HPMaximum: number; unit: HP.
- HPCurrent: number; unit: HP.
- FPMaximum: number; unit: FP.
- FPCurrent: number; unit: FP.
- HPCP: number; unit: CP.
- FPCP: number; unit: CP.
- WillCP: number; unit: CP.
- PerCP: number; unit: CP.
- Will: integer; unit: attribute-level.
- Per: integer; unit: attribute-level.

### Personal Derived Values and Defenses

For historical/original research scope only; not a required input of the current profile. Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 derived and defense slots.

- basicLift: number; unit: lb-context; BL-specific-unit-unverified.
- thrustDamage: string; unit: dice-expression.
- swingDamage: string; unit: dice-expression.
- basicSpeed: number; unit: unspecified-on-sheet.
- basicSpeedCP: number; unit: CP.
- basicMove: number; unit: unspecified-on-sheet.
- basicMoveCP: number; unit: CP.
- encumbranceLevel: integer; unit: printed-row-0..4.
- dodge: number; unit: defense-level.
- parry: number; unit: defense-level.
- block: number; unit: defense-level.
- DR: number; unit: DR-rating.

### Languages, Tech Level, and Culture

For historical/original research scope only; not a required input of the current profile. Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 Languages/TL/Cultural Familiarities.

- languages: array[{name:string,spoken:string|null,written:string|null,CP:number|null}]; unit: text + CP; proficiency vocabulary unspecified.
- TL: integer; unit: TL-level.
- TLCP: number; unit: CP.
- culturalFamiliarities: array[{name:string,CP:number|null}]; unit: text + CP.

### Traits and Reactions

For historical/original research scope only; not a required input of the current profile. Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 traits/reaction modifiers.

- advantagesPerks: array[{name:string,CP:number|null}]; unit: text + CP.
- disadvantagesQuirks: array[{name:string,CP:number|null}]; Unit: text + CP.
- reactionAppearance: number; Unit: modifier.
- reactionStatus: number; Unit: modifier.
- reactionReputation: number; Unit: modifier.
- reactionOther: array[{name:string,modifier:number|null}]; Unit: modifier.

### Learned Skills

For past/original-research scope only; not a required input of the current profile. Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 Skills Level Relative Level.

- skills: array[{name:string,level:number|null,relativeLevel:string|null,CP:number|null,controllingAttribute:string|null}]; Unit: skill-level + relative-expression + CP; controllingAttribute is original nullable normalization.

### Weapon Inputs

Owner: D15. Basis: PDF19/B336 Hand/Ranged Weapons.

- handWeapons: array[{weapon:string,damage:string|null,reach:string|null,parry:string|null,notes:string|null,cost:number|null,weight:number|null}]; Unit: damage/reach/parry printed notation; cost $, weight lb context.
- rangedWeapons: array[{weapon:string,damage:string|null,Acc:number|null,range:string|null,RoF:string|null,shots:string|null,ST:string|null,bulk:number|null,Rcl:number|null,LC:number|null,notes:string|null,cost:number|null,weight:number|null}]; Unit: mixed printed weapon statistics; detailed units unspecified.

### Armor and Possessions

Owner: D06. Basis: PDF19/B336 Armor & Possessions Cost Weight Totals.

- possessions: array[{item:string,location:string|null,cost:number|null,weight:number|null}]; Unit: cost $; weight lb.
- costTotal: number; Unit: $ reference currency, not Seoul money.
- weightTotal: number; Unit: lb.
- armorCoverage: array[{location:string,DR:number|null,source:string|null}]; Unit: DR-rating; original input, not printed coverage table.

### Point Categories

Owner: D01. Basis: PDF18/B335 Point Total/Unspent; PDF19/B336 Points Summary.

- pointTotal: number; Unit: CP.
- unspentPoints: number; Unit: CP.
- attributesSecondaryCP: number; Unit: CP.
- advantagesPerksTLLanguagesCultureCP: number; Unit: CP.
- disadvantagesQuirksCP: number; Unit: CP.
- skillsTechniquesCP: number; Unit: CP.
- otherCP: number; Unit: CP.

The maximum baseline and the current value of HP and FP are kept separate. This document does not determine whether the current value may be negative, nor how recovery or caps are handled. Speaking and writing a language are separate, and TL, cultural familiarity, items, and unspent points are not to be converted into skill purchases. A skill's absolute level, relative level, and points are each recorded separately, and if the controlling ability cannot be confirmed, it is left as null. The $ for equipment cost and lb for weight are reference units, not Seoul currency or transport-speed units. If the array itself is null, it means the original list is unknown; a confirmed empty list can be expressed as [].

## Calculations and Independent Examples

### REF-BL — Basic Lift

Owner: D01. Formula: `BLraw=ST*ST/5`.

The only thing confirmed from the original is the printed algebraic formula ST×ST/5. The example input restriction to positive ST only is a proposed data-type carrying range and is not an ST-range rule of the original. Negative-ST cases are left as applicability undetermined. The original's permitted range, BL-specific unit, and rounding have not been confirmed.

- bl12: Input `{"ST":12}` → Result `{"BLraw":28.8}`. This result is a calculation under the formula and state conditions qualified above and does not imply any additional policy.
- bl10: Input `{"ST":10}` → Result `{"BLraw":20}`. This result is a calculation under the formula and state conditions qualified above and does not imply any additional policy.
- blUnknown: Input `{"ST":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Undetermined policies or premises are not substituted with 0, prohibition, or success.
- blInvalid: Input `{"ST":-3}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null,"reason":"original-ST-range-unsupplied"}`. Undetermined policies or premises are not substituted with 0, prohibition, or success.

### REF-ENCUMBRANCE — Printed Encumbrance Rows

Status: original reference. Owner: D06.

Formula: `rowWeight=multiple*BL; MoveRaw=factor*BM; DodgeAdjusted=DodgeBase+penalty`. Input: BL, BM and Dodge bases with explicit row. Output unit: same respective input units.

Limitations: The row must be specified directly. The boundary rule for choosing a row by weight, the base movement and dodge formulas, minimum values, and individual rounding are undetermined.

- enc0: Input `{"row":0,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → Result `{"rowWeight":25,"MoveRaw":7,"DodgeAdjusted":10}`. This is the result of applying that row's weight multiple, movement factor, and dodge adjustment respectively.
- enc1: Input `{"row":1,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → Result `{"rowWeight":50,"MoveRaw":5.6,"DodgeAdjusted":9}`. This is the result of applying that row's weight multiple, movement factor, and dodge adjustment respectively.
- enc2: Input `{"row":2,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → Result `{"rowWeight":75,"MoveRaw":4.2,"DodgeAdjusted":8}`. This is the result of applying that row's weight multiple, movement factor, and dodge adjustment respectively.
- enc3: Input `{"row":3,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → Result `{"rowWeight":150,"MoveRaw":2.8,"DodgeAdjusted":7}`. This is the result of applying that row's weight multiple, movement factor, and dodge adjustment respectively.
- enc4: Input `{"row":4,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → Result `{"rowWeight":250,"MoveRaw":1.4,"DodgeAdjusted":6}`. This is the result of applying that row's weight multiple, movement factor, and dodge adjustment respectively.
- encUnknown: Input `{"row":2,"BL":25,"BM":null,"DodgeBase":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Because a required input or applicable rule is missing, the result is kept unresolved.
- encInvalid: Input `{"row":5}` → Result `{"status":"invalid-input","value":null}`. The input violates shape, range, or preservation conditions, so no result is produced.

### REF-RANGE-SUBSET — Abbreviated Range Lookup

Status: original reference. Owner: D15.

Formula: `0<=distance<=2 => 0; otherwise lookup only exact printed distance in yd`. Input: nonnegative distance yd. Output unit: modifier.

Limitations: Only directly printed distances and distances of 2 yd or less are looked up. No intermediate row selection, extrapolation, or speed combination is performed.

- range50: Input `{"distance":50}` → Result `{"modifier":-8}`. This is the result of directly looking up the corresponding printed distance row.
- range2: Input `{"distance":2}` → Result `{"modifier":0}`. This is the result of directly looking up the corresponding printed distance row.
- range700: Input `{"distance":700}` → Result `{"modifier":-15}`. This is the result of directly looking up the corresponding printed distance row.
- range4: Input `{"distance":4}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Because a required input or applicable rule is missing, the result is kept unresolved.
- range701: Input `{"distance":701}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Because a required input or applicable rule is missing, the result is kept unresolved.
- rangeNegative: Input `{"distance":-1}` → Result `{"status":"invalid-input","value":null}`. The input violates shape, range, or preservation conditions, so no result is produced.

### REF-HIT-LOCATION-SUBSET — Abbreviated Hit Locations

Status: original reference. Owner: D15.

Formula: `lookup printed location; vitals -3 and eyes -9 only when Imp or Pi note applies`. Input: location/type tags. Output unit: modifier.

Limits: Reads only the printed location and the Imp/Pi condition. Protected locations, injury multipliers, random locations, and missing locations are undetermined.

- hitFace: Input `{"location":"Face","attackType":"cut"}` → Result `{"modifier":-5}`. This is the result of directly applying the matching location row or the Imp/Pi conditional note.
- hitVitals: Input `{"location":"vitals","attackType":"Imp"}` → Result `{"modifier":-3}`. This is the result of directly applying the matching location row or the Imp/Pi conditional note.
- hitEyes: Input `{"location":"eyes","attackType":"Pi"}` → Result `{"modifier":-9}`. This is the result of directly applying the matching location row or the Imp/Pi conditional note.
- hitCutEyes: Input `{"location":"eyes","attackType":"cut"}` → Result `{"status":"not-covered","value":null}`. There is no basis for applying that notation to this attack type, so it is left outside the reference scope.
- hitUnknown: Input `{"location":"vitals","attackType":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. A required input or applicable rule is missing, so the result remains unresolved.

### REF-INTRO-3D — Intro 3d Roll Resolution

Owner: D01. Formula: `abbreviatedComparison=(d1+d2+d3)<=testedTarget`.

Shows only the abbreviated comparison of the sum of three d6 ≤ the notated target. This boolean is not the actual success roll result. Even 18≤20 is merely a true comparison, and since detailed critical rules are absent, actual success or failure is undetermined.

# 인물 시트와 도메인 계산 계약

상태: 제안. 승인된 규칙, 선택된 정책, 미채택 대안과 미정 수치를 구분한다. 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

2026-10-12 현재 인물 계약: 통솔·전략·교섭·운영·통찰·학습·기량·체력은 기본 정수 0–20, 최종 정수 0–100이다. 기본 10은 해당 분야 숙련자이며 특성·아이템·상태를 모두 적용한 최종값은 절대 100을 넘지 않는다. 서사 근거가 있는 개막 효과는 최종 20 초과를 허용한다. 행동 숙련은 역량과 별도 0–99.9이며 기량과 중복 계상하지 않는다. 특성은 수행·행동·스트레스·관계에 영향을 주고 사건·행동으로 획득한다. 신체는 왼팔·오른팔·왼다리·오른다리·머리·몸통의 손상 정도와 기능 상태, 별도 질병 진행을 기록하며 전투·역병이 같은 신체 기록을 사용한다. 판정식·효과 합성·숙련 성장식·개별 효과량·특성 목록·손상 및 기능 어휘는 미확정이다. 아래 GURPS CP·ST/DX/IQ/HT·HP/FP·비용표와 2026-10-08 대항 d10·0–12 기량·특성 범주·검증 사례는 명시적 과거/연구 판본에만 적용하며 새 profile의 필수 입력·산식·구현 증거가 아니다. 자동 환산과 미확인 값의 0 채움은 없다. 공개 profile은 승인된 공개 필드만 선택하고 비공개 모티브와 배정 원장을 포함하지 않는다.

이 문서는 인물의 기본 기록, 직접 확인한 원작 계산 표기, 서울에서 승인된 상태 규칙을 연결한다. 인물 한 명의 기록을 인구·권한·물류·전투 전체의 계산식으로 확대하지 않는다. 수치와 사례는 해당 입력이 알려진 경우만 계산하며, 미정 입력은 0이 아니라 미정으로 남긴다. 구현 완료나 모든 규칙의 채택을 뜻하지 않는다.

## 근거의 다섯 구분

- 원작 참조: GURPS Basic Set: Characters Fourth Edition, Version 10.0 – March 2024의 20쪽 미리보기에서 직접 읽은 표기다. PDF 18–19쪽은 인쇄 335–336쪽의 빈 인물 시트다. PDF 10–11쪽은 인쇄 8–9쪽의 소개와 일반 관례다. 빈 칸이나 목차·색인은 빠진 규칙 본문을 대신하지 않는다.
- 서울 승인: 인구 표현 보존, 반개방 예약, 검증된 도착의 포함 마감, 방향성 신뢰 분류, 항목별 협상 값 구조, 전쟁 점수 끝점, 단일 종결은 이미 승인된 범위만 유지한다.
- 선택 정책: 화물 분할은 부모 신원을 이력으로 퇴역시키고 물질을 두 자식으로 나누며, 실제 선택된 인수 근거는 수령자 확인 서명이다. 현재 보관 책임자 확인을 추가하는 양측 조건은 아래 사례의 미채택 공학 제안이며, 선택된 정책으로 인증하지 않는다. 협상 재평가가 명시적 권한과 새 판본·상태 스냅샷으로 수행되고 실제 무효화 사건이 기록되면 옛 수락을 무효화한다. 관련 상태 변경이나 요청 대기만으로 무효화된 것으로 보지 않는다. 이 선택은 전체 물류·협상 규칙이나 가격·수락 산식 승인이 아니다.
- 제안: 여기의 정규화된 자료형, 최대값/현재값 명칭, 도메인 시트 구성은 독자적인 기록 모델이다. 원작 양식 그림을 복사하지 않는다. 승인된 상태 의미와 자료형 제안을 구분한다.
- 빠진 규칙: 능력 비용, 기본 파생식, 기능 비용과 기본값, ST 피해표, 기본 방어식, 방호·부상·치명 결과, 전체 거리·명중 위치표, 서울 계수와 세력 제도는 미정이다.

## 계산과 독립 사례

### REF-BL — 기초 들어올리기

소유: D01. 식: `BLraw=ST*ST/5`.

원작 확인은 ST×ST/5라는 인쇄된 대수식뿐이다. 양수 ST만 다루는 예제 입력 제한은 제안된 자료형 운반 범위이며 원작의 ST 허용 범위 규칙이 아니다. 음수 ST 사례는 적용 가능성 미정으로 남긴다. 원작의 허용 범위·BL 전용 단위·반올림은 확인되지 않았다.

- bl12: 입력 `{"ST":12}` → 결과 `{"BLraw":28.8}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.
- bl10: 입력 `{"ST":10}` → 결과 `{"BLraw":20}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.
- blUnknown: 입력 `{"ST":null}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 미정 정책이나 전제는 0·금지·성공으로 대체하지 않는다.
- blInvalid: 입력 `{"ST":-3}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null,"reason":"original-ST-range-unsupplied"}`. 미정 정책이나 전제는 0·금지·성공으로 대체하지 않는다.

### REF-ENCUMBRANCE — 인쇄 부담 행

상태: 원작 참조. 소유: D06.

식: `rowWeight=multiple*BL; MoveRaw=factor*BM; DodgeAdjusted=DodgeBase+penalty`. 입력: BL, BM and Dodge bases with explicit row. 출력 단위: same respective input units.

한계: 행을 직접 지정해야 한다. 무게로 행을 고르는 경계 규칙, 기본 이동·회피식, 최저값과 개별 반올림은 미정이다.

- enc0: 입력 `{"row":0,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → 결과 `{"rowWeight":25,"MoveRaw":7,"DodgeAdjusted":10}`. 해당 행의 중량 배수·이동 계수·회피 보정을 각각 적용한 결과다.
- enc1: 입력 `{"row":1,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → 결과 `{"rowWeight":50,"MoveRaw":5.6,"DodgeAdjusted":9}`. 해당 행의 중량 배수·이동 계수·회피 보정을 각각 적용한 결과다.
- enc2: 입력 `{"row":2,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → 결과 `{"rowWeight":75,"MoveRaw":4.2,"DodgeAdjusted":8}`. 해당 행의 중량 배수·이동 계수·회피 보정을 각각 적용한 결과다.
- enc3: 입력 `{"row":3,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → 결과 `{"rowWeight":150,"MoveRaw":2.8,"DodgeAdjusted":7}`. 해당 행의 중량 배수·이동 계수·회피 보정을 각각 적용한 결과다.
- enc4: 입력 `{"row":4,"BL":25,"BM":7,"DodgeBase":10}` → 결과 `{"rowWeight":250,"MoveRaw":1.4,"DodgeAdjusted":6}`. 해당 행의 중량 배수·이동 계수·회피 보정을 각각 적용한 결과다.
- encUnknown: 입력 `{"row":2,"BL":25,"BM":null,"DodgeBase":null}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 필수 입력이나 적용 규칙이 없어 결과를 미정으로 유지한다.
- encInvalid: 입력 `{"row":5}` → 결과 `{"status":"invalid-input","value":null}`. 입력의 형태·범위·보존 조건을 위반하므로 결과를 만들지 않는다.

### REF-RANGE-SUBSET — 축약 거리 조회

상태: 원작 참조. 소유: D15.

식: `0<=distance<=2 => 0; otherwise lookup only exact printed distance in yd`. 입력: nonnegative distance yd. 출력 단위: modifier.

한계: 직접 인쇄된 거리와 2 yd 이하만 조회한다. 중간 행 선택·외삽·속도 합성은 하지 않는다.

- range50: 입력 `{"distance":50}` → 결과 `{"modifier":-8}`. 인쇄된 해당 거리 행을 직접 조회한 결과다.
- range2: 입력 `{"distance":2}` → 결과 `{"modifier":0}`. 인쇄된 해당 거리 행을 직접 조회한 결과다.
- range700: 입력 `{"distance":700}` → 결과 `{"modifier":-15}`. 인쇄된 해당 거리 행을 직접 조회한 결과다.
- range4: 입력 `{"distance":4}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 필수 입력이나 적용 규칙이 없어 결과를 미정으로 유지한다.
- range701: 입력 `{"distance":701}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 필수 입력이나 적용 규칙이 없어 결과를 미정으로 유지한다.
- rangeNegative: 입력 `{"distance":-1}` → 결과 `{"status":"invalid-input","value":null}`. 입력의 형태·범위·보존 조건을 위반하므로 결과를 만들지 않는다.

### REF-HIT-LOCATION-SUBSET — 축약 명중 위치

상태: 원작 참조. 소유: D15.

식: `lookup printed location; vitals -3 and eyes -9 only when Imp or Pi note applies`. 입력: location/type tags. 출력 단위: modifier.

한계: 인쇄 위치와 Imp/Pi 조건만 읽는다. 방호 위치·부상 배율·무작위 위치·누락 위치는 미정이다.

- hitFace: 입력 `{"location":"Face","attackType":"cut"}` → 결과 `{"modifier":-5}`. 해당 위치 행 또는 Imp/Pi 조건부 주석을 직접 적용한 결과다.
- hitVitals: 입력 `{"location":"vitals","attackType":"Imp"}` → 결과 `{"modifier":-3}`. 해당 위치 행 또는 Imp/Pi 조건부 주석을 직접 적용한 결과다.
- hitEyes: 입력 `{"location":"eyes","attackType":"Pi"}` → 결과 `{"modifier":-9}`. 해당 위치 행 또는 Imp/Pi 조건부 주석을 직접 적용한 결과다.
- hitCutEyes: 입력 `{"location":"eyes","attackType":"cut"}` → 결과 `{"status":"not-covered","value":null}`. 이 공격 유형에 해당 표기를 적용할 근거가 없으므로 참조 범위 밖으로 남긴다.
- hitUnknown: 입력 `{"location":"vitals","attackType":null}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 필수 입력이나 적용 규칙이 없어 결과를 미정으로 유지한다.

### REF-INTRO-3D — 소개부 3d 판정

소유: D01. 식: `abbreviatedComparison=(d1+d2+d3)<=testedTarget`.

세 d6 합≤표기 목표의 축약 비교만 표시한다. 이 불리언은 실제 성공 판정 결과가 아니다. 18≤20도 비교가 참일 뿐이며 상세 치명 규칙이 없으므로 실제 성공·실패는 미정이다.

- rollEqual: 입력 `{"dice":[3,4,5],"target":12}` → 결과 `{"sum":12,"abbreviatedComparison":true,"successRollResult":null}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.

- resTouch: 입력 `{"A":[11,19],"B":[19,27]}` → 결과 `{"overlap":false}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.
- resReverse: 입력 `{"A":[19,27],"B":[11,19]}` → 결과 `{"overlap":false}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.
- resOverlap: 입력 `{"A":[11,19],"B":[18,27]}` → 결과 `{"overlap":true}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.
- resMulti: 입력 `{"existing":[[11,19],[24,32]],"requested":[19,28]}` → 결과 `{"overlaps":[false,true],"refused":true}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.
- resZero: 입력 `{"A":[19,19],"B":[19,27]}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null,"reason":"zero-duration-action-policy-unknown"}`. 미정 정책이나 전제는 0·금지·성공으로 대체하지 않는다.
- resUnknown: 입력 `{"A":[11,19],"B":[null,27]}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 미정 정책이나 전제는 0·금지·성공으로 대체하지 않는다.

- resultNonClosure: 입력 `{"id":"R-note","applied":[],"closed":false,"validBoundary":true,"actualValidWarClosureResult":false,"priorSettlementCount":0}` → 결과 `{"effect":"apply-once-nonclosure","settlementCount":0,"warClosed":false}`. 이 결과는 위에서 한정한 식·상태 조건의 계산이며 추가 정책을 뜻하지 않는다.

부담 행은 BL 배수 1/2/3/6/10, 이동 계수 1/0.8/0.6/0.4/0.2, 회피 보정 0/−1/−2/−3/−4다. 실제 짐이 어느 행에 속하는지와 구체 반올림·최저 이동은 이 미리보기만으로 결정하지 않는다. 기초 속도·이동·회피의 기본값도 역산하지 않는다.

축약 거리 표는 yd 단위로 2:0, 3:-1, 5:-2, 7:-3, 10:-4, 15:-5, 20:-6, 30:-7, 50:-8, 70:-9, 100:-10, 150:-11, 200:-12, 300:-13, 500:-14, 700:-15이다. 첫 행만 2 yd 이하를 명시한다. 중간 거리의 행 선택과 700 yd 이후 값은 전체 표 규칙을 요구한다. 명중 위치는 몸통 0, 팔/다리 −2, 사타구니 −3, 손 −4, 얼굴 −5, 두개골 −7이며 Imp/Pi 공격의 급소 −3·눈 −9는 조건부 표기다. 이 값으로 방호 위치·부상 배율을 만들지 않는다.

일반 비용 올림과 행동·전투 내림에는 해당 규칙의 예외가 우선한다. BL이나 실제 이동의 구체 예외를 모르는 상황에서 일반 관례를 적용해 확정 결과를 만들지 않는다. 소개부 3d 비교는 전체 성공·실패 분류가 아니므로 극단 주사위의 치명 결과를 추가하지 않는다.

인구 보존은 출생·사망·이주·포획이 없는 표현 이동에 한한다. 예약 경계 허용은 같은 사람의 양의 구간 점유만 정하며 영시간 행동 정책은 미정이고 장비·시설 용량도 보장하지 않는다. 마감 포함은 시간상 자격만 정하며 최종 가용 재고는 별도 인수·신원·보관·권리 조건을 요구한다. 양측 확인은 미채택 조건부 제안으로 계산한다. 신뢰 −50은 적과 숙적 조건을 함께 만족하며 배타 표시 우선순위를 새로 정하지 않는다. V와 W는 별도 수이고 가격 미등록은 무료가 아니다. 유효 명분·수혜자를 먼저 확인한 뒤 ±100을 처리하며 같은 시각 사건 종류의 미정 우선순위를 만들어 승자를 결정하지 않는다.

title: Domain Situations and Standalone Cases
body_md:
# Domain Situations and Standalone Cases

Status: Proposed. This distinguishes approved rules, selected policies, unadopted alternatives, and undecided values. It does not mean implementation is complete.

[Design Guide](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [Sheets, Calculations, and Full Cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

Each situation describes the actors, inputs, decisions, and the state before and after the action. Situation examples do not replace the full rules. [Situation Report](https://evidence.linalab.io/evidence/seoul-gdd-sheets-situations-20261007-f2bbda37-c30b-4c23-8684-b51724045d48/situations.html) · [Domain Design Proposal Reader](https://evidence.linalab.io/evidence/seoul-gdd-sheets-situations-20261007-f2bbda37-c30b-4c23-8684-b51724045d48/index.html). The reader is a design document that distinguishes the approved scope from unadopted proposals.

## D01

### Choosing Between Namesakes

[D01 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d01/)

- Actors: the player, two characters with the same name
- Inputs: different permanent IDs, display names, and distinguishing information
- Decision: select one ID from the candidate list
- Eligibility and boundaries: final identity is determined by the stable ID
- Before: two characters use the same name
- Action: search by name, then select using the distinguishing information
- After: only the selected ID's records are referenced
- Failure: the first name match is not treated as the same person
- Preserved facts: permanent identity and the other character's records

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: REF-BL, REF-INTRO-3D, REF-ROUND-COST. State contract: STATE-D01. The source text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undecided inputs: Costs; derived bases; skill defaults and CP allocations. Do not fill undecided values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D01: input `{"nameChanged":true,"id":"P-a"}` → result `{"samePerson":true}`. Independent basis: Name change leaves stable ID unchanged. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D01-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D02

### Insufficient Treatment Conditions

[D02 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d02/)

- Actors: the injured character, the treatment provider
- Inputs: injury, rest schedule, current location, absence of a healer, a place to lie down, and water
- Decision: request treatment
- Eligibility and boundaries: checks for safety, physiology, location, and resources
- Before: an injury and an existing schedule are in place
- Action: check the actual treatment conditions
- After: it does not count as treatment, and the injury and schedule remain
- Failure: who defers, refuses, or negotiates is undecided
- Preserved facts: permanent ID and the existing schedule

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: no numeric formula. State contract: STATE-D02. The source text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undecided inputs: Injury/shock/recovery; needs and fatigue coefficients. Do not fill undecided values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D02: input `{"identity":"P-a","injured":true}` → result `{"identity":"P-a","automaticDeletion":false}`. Independent basis: Injury is state, not identity deletion. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D02-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D03

### Remote Delivery and Loss of Authority

[D03 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d03/)

- Actors: the sender, the recipient, the delegator
- Inputs: remote location, contact channel, delegation version
- Decision: request to move the scope of delegation
- Eligibility and boundaries: the actual channel, receipt, acceptance, and authority before execution
- Before: the delegation is valid at the time of sending
- Action: deliver through the channel, then recheck authority upon receipt
- After: only accepted commands are scheduled and executed
- Failure: absence of a channel means no receipt; if the delegation lapses before arrival, nothing is executed
- Preserved facts: independent daily life, completed progress and consumption

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: SEOUL-RESERVATION. State contract: STATE-D03. The source text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undecided inputs: Delivery durations; acceptance; priority and cancellation rules. Do not fill undecided values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D03: input `{"remote":true,"received":false}` → result `{"execution":false}`. Independent basis: Unreceived command cannot execute. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D03-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D04

### Mustered, Then Returned from Treatment

[D04 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d04/)

- Actors: 500 aggregate residents, 5 individualized, 3 unit roles
- Input: existing unique IDs, aggregate and individual counts, role reservations
- Decision: assign to units after individualization, 1 returns after treatment
- Eligibility and bounds: no overlapping role reservations; return eligibility; no population event
- Before: aggregate 500 / individual 0
- Action: 5 individualized, 3 mustered, 1 returned from treatment
- After: aggregate 496 / individual 4 / total 500
- Failure: second overlapping role rejected; death is a separate population event
- Preserved facts: same ID, labor and treatment history, consumption

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: SEOUL-POPULATION, SEOUL-RESERVATION. State contract: STATE-D04. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: Wages/rations/shortage; return eligibility and capacity conversion. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D04: input `{"individualized":true}` → result `{"aggregateAvailableLabor":false}`. Independent rationale: Same person not counted twice. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D04-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent rationale: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D05

### Repair Halted and Unused Materials

[D05 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d05/)

- Actors: performer, halting authority, owner, custodian
- Input: 4 materials used, 8 unused, completed progress
- Decision: authorized phase halt
- Eligibility and bounds: current phase and halting authority; consumed portion separated
- Before: partially completed repair and on-site materials
- Action: stop the phase and inspect the remaining contract
- After: completed progress and 8 units preserved; no automatic refund of the 4
- Failure: if inputs or eligibility are insufficient, no new consumption or output
- Preserved facts: material ownership and completed progress

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: SEOUL-CUTOFF, SEOUL-RESERVATION. State contract: STATE-D05. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: Production yields; duration; power and storage timing. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D05: input `{"progressCompleted":true,"cancelled":true}` → result `{"progressPreserved":true,"automaticRefund":false}`. Independent rationale: Completed work and consumed inputs not rewound. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D05-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent rationale: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D06

### Late Cargo and Receipt Conditions

[D06 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d06/)

- Actors: carrier, receiver, current custodian
- Input: cargo ID, actual arrival 481, deadline 480, receipt and rights evidence
- Decision: arrival verification and receipt request
- Eligibility and bounds: the deadline only determines time inclusion; selected receiver's signature and separate rights conditions
- Before: cargo is in transit
- Action: confirm the actual arrival record and compare it with 480
- After: excluded from the 480 deadline; actual location and identity carry into the next determination
- Failure: receipt verification failure is quarantined locally; additional custodian confirmation is an unadopted proposal
- Preserved facts: quantity, ownership, custody, provenance

Classification: selected-receiver-policy; additional-custodian-guard-unadopted-proposal. Reference calculations: REF-BL, REF-ENCUMBRANCE, SEOUL-CARGO-CONSERVATION, SEOUL-CUTOFF, SEOUL-CARGO-RECEIPT-GUARDS. State contract: STATE-D06. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: World travel time; fatigue; paths; receipt protocol and map aging. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- Unadopted two-party confirmation proposal case. receipt-false-false: input `{"currentCustodianConfirmed":false,"receiverConfirmed":false,"temporalEligibility":true,"identityCustodyRightsValid":true,"otherReceiptConditions":true}` → result `{"receiptComplete":false,"finalAvailableStock":false}`. Independent rationale: Conjunction requires both current-custodian and receiver confirmation and every separate guard. This is an example, not policy. Additional custodian confirmation is a premise of the unadopted conditional proposal and is not the selected receipt policy.
- Unadopted two-party confirmation proposal case. receipt-false-true: input `{"currentCustodianConfirmed":false,"receiverConfirmed":true,"temporalEligibility":true,"identityCustodyRightsValid":true,"otherReceiptConditions":true}` → result `{"receiptComplete":false,"finalAvailableStock":false}`. Independent rationale: Conjunction requires both current-custodian and receiver confirmation and every separate guard. This is an example, not policy. Additional custodian confirmation is a premise of the unadopted conditional proposal and is not the selected receipt policy.
- Unadopted two-party confirmation proposal case. receipt-true-false: input `{"currentCustodianConfirmed":true,"receiverConfirmed":false,"temporalEligibility":true,"identityCustodyRightsValid":true,"otherReceiptConditions":true}` → result `{"receiptComplete":false,"finalAvailableStock":false}`. Independent rationale: Conjunction requires both current-custodian and receiver confirmation and every separate guard. This is an example, not policy. Additional custodian confirmation is a premise of the unadopted conditional proposal and is not the selected receipt policy.
- Unadopted two-party confirmation proposal case. receipt-true-true: input `{"currentCustodianConfirmed":true,"receiverConfirmed":true,"temporalEligibility":true,"identityCustodyRightsValid":true,"otherReceiptConditions":true}` → result `{"receiptComplete":true,"finalAvailableStock":true}`. Independent rationale: Conjunction requires both current-custodian and receiver confirmation and every separate guard. This is an example, not policy. Additional custodian confirmation is a premise of the unadopted conditional proposal and is not the selected receipt policy.
- Unadopted two-party confirmation proposal case. receipt-rights-missing: input `{"currentCustodianConfirmed":true,"receiverConfirmed":true,"temporalEligibility":true,"identityCustodyRightsValid":null,"otherReceiptConditions":true}` → result `{"receiptComplete":true,"finalAvailableStock":null,"status":"unresolved"}`. Independent rationale: Both confirmations do not supply missing custody/rights facts. This is an example, not policy. Additional custodian confirmation is a premise of the unadopted conditional proposal and is not the selected receipt policy.
- Unadopted two-party confirmation proposal case. state-D06-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent rationale: Unknown guards do not complete receipt or establish available stock. This is an example, not policy. Additional custodian confirmation is a premise of the unadopted conditional proposal and is not the selected receipt policy.

## D07

### Late Discovery of a Hidden Betrayal

[D07 Full Standalone Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d07/)

- Actors: traitor Eul, observer Gap, unaware party Jeong
- Input: t0 event, t2 sourced report, directional trust
- Decision: report-based evaluation
- Eligibility and bounds: the evaluating party actually becomes aware through observation or report
- Before: at t0, Gap does not know of the event
- Action: when t2 is reported, only A's own trust and memory are updated
- After: judgments at t0–t2 are not changed retroactively; defined trust is not updated
- Failure: re-receiving the same result ID is not reapplied
- Preserved facts: distinction between world facts and personal knowledge

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: SEOUL-RELATION-CLASS, SEOUL-SINGLE-RESULT. State contract: STATE-D07. The source text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undetermined inputs: Change/decay/duration and evaluation coefficients. Do not fill undetermined values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D07: input `{"eventObserved":false}` → result `{"trustUpdatedByEvent":false}`. Independent basis: Unknown event cannot update observer. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D07-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D08

### Border Marriage Consent and Undetermined Institution

[Full D08 Reader Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d08/)

- Actors: A (α), B (β), ratification recorder
- Input: 2 consents, 1 ratification, applicable institution undetermined
- Decision: request to determine whether the marriage is established
- Eligibility and boundaries: a consent record does not substitute for the validity or sufficiency of the institution
- Before: no marriage record; each party's claims, property, and positions
- Action: record the consents and ratification
- After: 3 records; establishment and effects are undetermined
- Failure: an undetermined institution is different from non-establishment or prohibition
- Preserved facts: the records, and independent rights, affiliations, and positions

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: no numeric formula. State contract: STATE-D08. The source text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undetermined inputs: Faction marriage/adoption eligibility; consent effects and shares. Do not fill undetermined values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D08: input `{"validExistingMarriage":true,"newLawInputMissing":true}` → result `{"existingMarriagePreserved":true,"newMarriageResult":null}`. Independent basis: Existing fact preserved, new formation unresolved. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D08-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D09

### Loss of Office by a Living Person

[Full D09 Reader Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d09/)

- Actors: recorded office holder, institution, escort contract counterparty
- Input: recorded office and a separate valid escort contract
- Decision: apply the loss of office
- Eligibility and boundaries: separate the authority of that office from the separate contract
- Before: one person holds both a recorded office and an escort contract
- Action: confirm the grounds for loss of office
- After: ratification signing is suspended; the escort is judged under its own contract
- Failure: a vacancy alone does not cause inheritance, delegation, or absorption of authority
- Preserved facts: personal life and movement, ownership of the institution's treasury

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: no numeric formula. State contract: STATE-D09. The source text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undetermined inputs: Faction office eligibility/election/regency and legitimacy coefficients. Do not fill undetermined values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D09: input `{"alive":true,"officeLost":true}` → result `{"officeAuthority":false,"automaticPropertyTransfer":false}`. Independent basis: Only office power ceases. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D09-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D10

### Ending Support for Another's Claim

[Full D10 Reader Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d10/)

- Actors: attacker Narae, beneficiary Daon
- Input: casus belli version, fixed objective, beneficiary eligibility, W=100
- Decision: request to end the war
- Eligibility and boundaries: re-check the casus belli and the beneficiary first
- Before: a valid support war; occupation outside the objective also exists
- Action: check whether the casus belli remains valid and check the beneficiary
- After: if valid, only the targets in the version are transferred, with Daon as the basis
- Failure: if already invalid, the invalidity rules apply; occupation alone confers no rights
- Preserved facts: rights outside the objective, institutional treasuries, on-site takeover boundaries

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculation: SEOUL-W-ENDPOINT. State contract: STATE-D10. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Undetermined inputs: Claim lists; creation cost; recognized institution and persistence effects. Do not fill undetermined values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D10: input `{"claim":true,"validCause":false}` → result `{"warCreated":false}`. Independent basis: Claim alone does not supply registered cause. This is an example, not a policy.
- state-D10-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not a policy.

## D11

### Successful Conferral but Key Not Handed Over

[Full D11 Reader Rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d11/)

- Actors: conferrer A, recipient B, occupier C
- Input: title set T with consent and ratification completed; key held by A
- Decision: change the rights ledger and take over
- Eligibility and boundaries: the specified scope of rights and completed ratification
- Before: held by A; treasury and troop command are outside the draft
- Action: Transfer the same title ID from Party A's list to Party B's list
- After: B holds the right, but the acquisition is incomplete; C's occupation counts as control/dispute
- Failure: If not ratified, the original holder is retained; cannot be duplicated through two grants
- Preserved facts: title ID, vault/command outside the draft, consumption/progress

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculation: no numeric formula. State contract: STATE-D11. The source text for calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved input: Faction ratification/revocation and contract termination details. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D11: Input `{"delegation":true}` → Result `{"holderChanged":false}`. Independent basis: Delegation preserves original holder. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D11-unknown: Input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D12

### Living Permanent Detention and Principal Transition

[Full Standalone Rules for D12](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d12/)

- Actors: detained principal, designated successor, counterparty to the position/contract
- Input: permanent detention, survival, designated successor
- Decision: principal transition
- Eligibility and boundaries: detention contract, position/separate contract terms, return authority kept separate
- Before: The principal is alive and holds their own property
- Action: Only the principal is transitioned to the designated successor
- After: No death inheritance; the detainee's property is retained
- Failure: Return after release requires a separate explicit authority; the specific authority holder is undecided
- Preserved facts: detainee's survival, property, per-item contracts

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculation: no numeric formula. State contract: STATE-D12. The source text for calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved input: Successor eligibility; no-successor continuation and explicit return authority. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D12: Input `{"alive":true,"permanentlyDetained":true}` → Result `{"deathInheritanceOpened":false}`. Independent basis: Living detention distinct from death. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D12-unknown: Input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D13

### Registered Will and Collateral Maintenance

[Full Standalone Rules for D13](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d13/)

- Actors: deceased P, beneficiaries H and B, carrier C, colleague R
- Input: one each of E, S, M, and K; collateral L; eligibility and full-allocation approval assumed
- Decision: allocate E and S as designated in the will
- Eligibility and boundaries: registered will, legal eligibility, per-asset approval
- Before: personal estate 4; R is a person, outside the estate
- Action: Assign E to H and S to B; hold M and K
- After: 2 assigned + 2 held = 4; collateral L maintained
- Failure: Ownership transfer is not physical delivery; no automatic debt imposed
- Preserved facts: the four IDs and quantities, C's custody and route, R's personhood

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculation: SEOUL-CARGO-CONSERVATION, SEOUL-SINGLE-RESULT. State contract: STATE-D13. The source text for calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved input: Inheritance shares; family laws; debt priority and partial-delivery remedies. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D13: Input `{"signed":true,"physicallyDelivered":false}` → Result `{"deliveryComplete":false}`. Independent basis: Signature is not transport. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D13-unknown: Input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D14

### Teacher's Death and Education Cancellation

[Full Standalone Rules for D14](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d14/)

- Actors: learner, teacher, facility/material owner
- Input: 2 completed practice sessions, 5 reserved materials, 2 consumed, 3 unused
- Decision: re-examine the next practice session
- Eligibility and boundaries: the required teacher for that skill; the case contract releases unused reservations
- Before: next practice session accepted; teacher alive
- Action: Record the reason for suspension after the teacher's death
- After: 2 completed retained; 2 consumed retained; only the 3 unused released
- Failure: Whether a new teacher request is accepted and whether progress is recognized are handled separately
- Preserved facts: existing proficiency, documents already read, completed progress

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculation: no numeric formula. State contract: STATE-D14. The source text for calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved input: Study duration/cost; skill-cost progression and qualification conversion. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D14: Input `{"documentInherited":true,"practiceKnown":false}` → Result `{"skillLevelDerived":null}`. Independent basis: No document-to-skill conversion supplied. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D14-unknown: Input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → Result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D15

### Late-Arriving Reinforcements and Separate Command Authority

[Full Standalone Rules for D15](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d15/)

- Actors: Dasol Unit, principal commander, battle session
- Input: actual arrival 12, end 13; no registered attachment
- Decision: participation in an ongoing battle
- Eligibility and boundaries: actual arrival and battle in progress; direct control is separate from attachment and command scope
- Before: a unit not on the initial roster is in transit
- Action: check the confirmed order of arrival and end
- After: reinforcement participation allowed; no automatic creation of main-body command authority
- Failure: if arrival 12 comes after end 11, no participation; unconfirmed simultaneous order is unresolved
- Preserved facts: unit existence and arrival location

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: REF-INTRO-3D, REF-ENCUMBRANCE, REF-RANGE-SUBSET, REF-HIT-LOCATION-SUBSET, REF-ROUND-FEAT, SEOUL-POPULATION, SEOUL-RESERVATION. State contract: STATE-D15. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: Base defenses; ST damage; DR injury; critical rules; squad losses; capacity and Spear15/16. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D15: input `{"battleActive":true,"actuallyArrived":true,"commandScope":false}` → result `{"reinforcementEligible":true,"commandAuthority":false}`. Independent basis: Participation and authority separate. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D15-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D16

### War Boundary Where Invalidity Comes First

[Full D16 original rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d16/)

- Actors: attacker, beneficiary, casus belli holder
- Input: W=90, capital occupation +10 candidate, basis of casus belli extinguished
- Decision: forced-termination evaluation
- Eligibility and boundary: validity of the casus belli and beneficiary comes before the endpoint effect
- Before: the score endpoint candidate and the invalidity fact are on the same boundary
- Action: casus belli invalidity check
- After: invalidity rule terminates the war; a +100 victory does not create any right
- Failure: if validity or event order is unresolved, no termination without a basis
- Preserved facts: completed occupation work and consumption; rights outside the objective

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: SEOUL-W-ENDPOINT, SEOUL-SINGLE-RESULT. State contract: STATE-D16. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: Occupation denominator/rate; diplomacy costs; treaty and captive rules. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D16: input `{"W":100,"causeValid":false}` → result `{"forceVictoryApplied":false}`. Independent basis: Invalidity before endpoint. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D16-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

## D17

### Related State Changes and Reevaluation

[Full D17 original rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d17/)

- Actors: proposer, acceptor, explicitly authorized reevaluator
- Input: old acceptance, changed state, new version and snapshot, invalidation event
- Decision: explicit reevaluation of the existing proposal
- Eligibility and boundary: actual performance by an authorized party, new version, and invalidation record
- Before: the state changes after the old snapshot was accepted
- Action: separate the pending request from the actual performance
- After: only a performed reevaluation invalidates the old acceptance; the new settlement is unresolved
- Failure: do not assume invalidation from a change or a pending request alone; no automatic acceptance when V≤W
- Preserved facts: proposal identity, version history, and target rights

Classification: selected-bounded-reevaluation; no-price-or-acceptance-function. Reference calculations: SEOUL-NEGOTIATION-V, SEOUL-W-ENDPOINT, SEOUL-SINGLE-RESULT. State contract: STATE-D17. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: Price and acceptance functions; reservation timing; remedies and simultaneous admission priority. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D17-performed: input `{"acceptedOldSnapshot":true,"relevantStateChanged":true,"explicitAuthorizedRepricingPerformed":true,"newSnapshotVersion":true,"explicitInvalidationEvent":true}` → result `{"reevaluationState":"performed","oldAcceptanceValid":false,"renewedSettlement":null}`. Independent basis: Authorized event, new snapshot/version and actual invalidation supplied; no automatic new settlement. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D17-pending: input `{"acceptedOldSnapshot":true,"relevantStateChanged":true,"explicitAuthorizedRepricingPerformed":false,"newSnapshotVersion":false,"explicitInvalidationEvent":false}` → result `{"reevaluationState":"pending-request","automaticInvalidation":false,"oldAcceptanceValidityForChangedState":null,"renewedSettlement":null}`. Independent basis: State change identifies reevaluation need only; no performed invalidation or current-state acceptance verdict. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D17-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown event/authority cannot supply invalidation. This is an example, not policy.

## D18

### Loading a Corrupted Save

[Full D18 original rules](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d18/)

- Actors: player, campaign state holder
- Input: corrupted save, current state, compatible version
- Decision: load request
- Eligibility and boundary: consistent boundary, version, and integrity
- Before: the current campaign state is live
- Action: check the save for corruption and compatibility
- After: explicit error; current state unchanged
- Failure: no partial load and no substitution of a new campaign
- Preserved facts: current world state and event/result records

Classification: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. Reference calculations: SEOUL-CUTOFF, SEOUL-SINGLE-RESULT. State contract: STATE-D18. The original text of the calculations and constraints follows [Full calculation cases](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/).

Unresolved inputs: Tick/phase values; simultaneous final order; save-error limit and migration contract. Do not fill unresolved values with 0, prohibition, or success.

### Standalone State Cases

- state-D18: input `{"loadCorrupt":true}` → result `{"liveStateMutated":false,"explicitError":true}`. Independent basis: No partial load or fallback campaign. This is an example, not policy.
- state-D18-unknown: input `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → result `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. Independent basis: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. This is an example, not policy.

# 도메인 상황과 독립 사례

상태: 제안. 승인된 규칙, 선택된 정책, 미채택 대안과 미정 수치를 구분한다. 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

[설계 길잡이](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index/) · [시트·계산·전체 사례](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)

각 상황은 배우·입력·결정과 행동 전후의 상태를 설명한다. 상황 예시는 전체 규칙을 대체하지 않는다. [상황 보고서](https://evidence.linalab.io/evidence/seoul-gdd-sheets-situations-20261007-f2bbda37-c30b-4c23-8684-b51724045d48/situations.html) · [영역별 설계 제안 읽기본](https://evidence.linalab.io/evidence/seoul-gdd-sheets-situations-20261007-f2bbda37-c30b-4c23-8684-b51724045d48/index.html). 읽기본은 승인 범위와 미채택 제안을 구분하는 설계 자료다.

## D01

### 동명이인 선택

[D01 전체 독자 규칙](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d01/)

- 배우: 플레이어, 같은 이름의 두 인물
- 입력: 서로 다른 영구 ID, 표시 이름, 구분 정보
- 결정: 후보 목록에서 한 ID 선택
- 자격과 경계: 최종 동일성은 안정 ID
- 전: 두 인물이 같은 이름을 쓴다
- 행동: 이름 검색 후 구분 정보로 선택
- 후: 선택한 ID의 기록만 참조
- 실패: 이름 첫 일치를 동일인으로 취급하지 않는다
- 보존 사실: 영구 신원과 다른 인물 기록

분류: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. 참조 계산: REF-BL, REF-INTRO-3D, REF-ROUND-COST. 상태 계약: STATE-D01. 계산과 제약의 원문은 [전체 계산 사례](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)를 따른다.

미정 입력: Costs; derived bases; skill defaults and CP allocations. 미정을 0·금지·성공으로 채우지 않는다.

### 독립 상태 사례

- state-D01: 입력 `{"nameChanged":true,"id":"P-a"}` → 결과 `{"samePerson":true}`. 독립 근거: Name change leaves stable ID unchanged. 예시이며 정책이 아니다.
- state-D01-unknown: 입력 `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 독립 근거: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. 예시이며 정책이 아니다.

## D02

### 치료 조건 부족

[D02 전체 독자 규칙](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d02/)

- 배우: 다친 인물, 치료 제공자
- 입력: 부상, 휴식 일정, 현재 장소, 치료자·자리·물 부재
- 결정: 치료 요청
- 자격과 경계: 안전·생리·장소·자원 검사
- 전: 부상과 기존 일정이 있다
- 행동: 실제 치료 조건을 검사
- 후: 치료로 성립하지 않으며 부상·일정 유지
- 실패: 보류·거절·교섭 주체는 미정
- 보존 사실: 영구 ID와 기존 일정

분류: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. 참조 계산: 수치식 없음. 상태 계약: STATE-D02. 계산과 제약의 원문은 [전체 계산 사례](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)를 따른다.

미정 입력: Injury/shock/recovery; needs and fatigue coefficients. 미정을 0·금지·성공으로 채우지 않는다.

### 독립 상태 사례

- state-D02: 입력 `{"identity":"P-a","injured":true}` → 결과 `{"identity":"P-a","automaticDeletion":false}`. 독립 근거: Injury is state, not identity deletion. 예시이며 정책이 아니다.
- state-D02-unknown: 입력 `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 독립 근거: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. 예시이며 정책이 아니다.

## D03

### 원격 전달과 권한 소멸

[D03 전체 독자 규칙](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d03/)

- 배우: 발신자, 수신자, 위임자
- 입력: 원격 위치, 연락 경로, 위임 판본
- 결정: 위임 범위 이동 요청
- 자격과 경계: 실제 경로·수신·수락 및 실행 전 권한
- 전: 발신 때 위임은 유효
- 행동: 경로 전달 후 수신 시 권한 재검사
- 후: 수락한 명령만 예약·실행
- 실패: 경로 부재는 무수신; 도착 전 위임 소멸은 무실행
- 보존 사실: 독립 생활, 완료 진척·소비

분류: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. 참조 계산: SEOUL-RESERVATION. 상태 계약: STATE-D03. 계산과 제약의 원문은 [전체 계산 사례](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)를 따른다.

미정 입력: Delivery durations; acceptance; priority and cancellation rules. 미정을 0·금지·성공으로 채우지 않는다.

### 독립 상태 사례

- state-D03: 입력 `{"remote":true,"received":false}` → 결과 `{"execution":false}`. 독립 근거: Unreceived command cannot execute. 예시이며 정책이 아니다.
- state-D03-unknown: 입력 `{"prerequisiteFacts":null}` → 결과 `{"status":"unresolved","value":null}`. 독립 근거: Unknown prerequisites cannot invent a new fact or effect; preserve existing valid state. 예시이며 정책이 아니다.

## D04

### 소집 후 치료 복귀

[D04 전체 독자 규칙](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d04/)

- 배우: 집계 주민 500, 개인화 5, 부대 역할 3
- 입력: 기존 고유 ID, 집계·개인 수, 역할 예약
- 결정: 개인화 후 부대 배정, 치료 뒤 1명 복귀
- 자격과 경계: 겹치는 역할 예약 없음; 복귀 자격; 인구 사건 없음
- 전: 집계 500 / 개인 0
- 행동: 5명 개인화, 3명 소집, 1명 치료 복귀
- 후: 집계 496 / 개인 4 / 총 500
- 실패: 겹치는 둘째 역할 거절; 사망은 별도 인구 사건
- 보존 사실: 같은 ID, 노동·치료 이력, 소비

분류: bounded-Seoul-state-semantics; proposed-sheet-model. 참조 계산: SEOUL-POPULATION, SEOUL-RESERVATION. 상태 계약: STATE-D04. 계산과 제약의 원문은 [전체 계산 사례](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/)를 따른다.

body_md:
# D08 Operating Contract and Official Sheet for Houses, Kinship, Marriage, and Adoption

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/relationships-houses-and-intrigue/)

Records the governing law, the parties' consent, ratification, the establishment of the marriage, and its individual effects separately. Marriage alone does not transfer claims, territory, offices, or property, and adoption requires both the parties' consent and an approved procedure.

Status: a scoped operating contract. It distinguishes the public Lite's reference calculations, Seoul's approved procedures and preservation rules, and unapproved proposals. A proposal-held item is a deferred entry that cannot be executed, and it is neither 0 nor an approved figure. This document does not imply full-domain numerical completion or a runtime implementation.

[Domain Design](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d08/) · [Character Sheet and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [Saving and Versions](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [Singleplayer Contract](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## Processing Order and Responsibility Boundaries

1. Verifies the identities of the act, outcome, participants, and governing law, along with the rules and amendments.
2. Applies only registered and authorized governing laws, and does not arbitrarily select an unconfirmed jurisdiction.
3. Records consent and ratification separately, and does not finalize the establishment of a marriage without a jurisdiction ruling.
4. An established marriage by itself does not create a new claim or a territorial transfer.
5. On death, detention, or loss of office, assesses the effects on alliances, property, ratification, and succession separately.
6. For jointly held property, verifies the signatures of all current owners, but leaves the reflection of ownership to a separate ledger.
7. If there is no adoption procedure, preserves the consent record and leaves the matter pending.
8. Does not treat a synthetic person recognized as having personhood as transferable property.
9. Records outcomes and amendments atomically, and does not convert an unconfirmed state into a rejection or approval.

## Normalized Data and Formula Contract

Declare together the owner, read/write scope, units, snapshot, and point of application. Validation of formats and conservation formulas does not substitute for actual ledger issuance or the adoption of undecided functions. rulesVersion and the hash of the linked canonical source identify the source version and do not create any arbitrary new execution version.

# D08 가문·친족·혼인·양자 작동 계약과 공식 시트

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다.

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/relationships-houses-and-intrigue/)

관할 법, 당사자 동의, 인준, 혼인 성립과 개별 효과를 각각 기록한다. 혼인만으로 명분·영토·직위·재산이 이전되지 않으며 양자는 당사자 동의와 승인된 절차를 함께 요구한다.

상태: 범위가 한정된 작동 계약. 공개 Lite의 참조 계산, 서울의 승인된 절차·보존 규칙, 미승인 제안을 구분한다. proposal-held는 실행할 수 없는 보류 항목이며 0이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 이 문서는 전체 도메인 수치 완성이나 런타임 구현을 뜻하지 않는다.

## 처리 순서와 책임 경계

1. 행위·결과·참여자·관할 법의 신원과 규칙·개정을 확인한다.
2. 등록되고 권한이 있는 관할 법만 적용하며 미확인 관할을 임의로 선택하지 않는다.
3. 동의와 인준을 별도 기록하고 관할 판정 없이 혼인 성립을 확정하지 않는다.
4. 성립한 혼인 자체는 새 명분·영토 이전을 만들지 않는다.
5. 사망·구금·직위 상실 시 동맹·재산·인준·후계 효과를 각각 판단한다.
6. 공동재산은 현재 소유자 전원의 서명을 확인하되 소유권 반영은 별도 원장에 맡긴다.
7. 양자 절차가 없으면 동의 기록을 보존하고 미결로 남긴다.
8. 인격이 인정된 합성 인물을 양도 가능한 재산으로 처리하지 않는다.
9. 결과와 개정을 원자적으로 기록하며 미확인 상태를 거절·허용으로 바꾸지 않는다.

## 정규화된 데이터·공식 계약

소유자, 읽기·쓰기 범위, 단위, 스냅샷과 반영 시점을 함께 선언한다. 형식과 보존식의 검증은 실제 원장 발급이나 미정 함수의 채택을 대신하지 않는다. rulesVersion과 연결 정본의 해시는 원천 판본을 식별하며 임의의 새 실행 판본을 만들지 않는다.

title: D02 Health, Needs, Injury, and Treatment Operating Contract and Formula Sheet
title_ko: D02 건강·욕구·부상·치료 작동 계약과 공식 시트
body_md:
# D02 Health, Needs, Injury, and Treatment Operating Contract and Formula Sheet

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/characters-and-persons/)

The current body is recorded as six parts: left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head, and torso. Degree of damage and functional state are distinguished, and disease progression is kept as a separate state. Combat and plague both affect the same body record. The HP and FP fields and reference formulas below belong to the past or to the research scope and are not required aggregate formulas of the new system. Food, water, needs, and mood are separate states. A treatment request is distinguished from its actual performance, and the same cause or effect is not settled twice. The vocabulary for damage and function, and the numeric rules for disease, recovery, incapacitation, and death, are not yet finalized.

Status: a scoped operating contract. It distinguishes the public Lite's reference calculations, Seoul's approved procedures and preservation rules, and unapproved proposals. A proposal-held item is a deferred entry that cannot be executed, and it is neither 0 nor an approved figure. This document does not imply full-domain numerical completion or a runtime implementation.

[Domain Design](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d02/) · [Personal Sheet and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [Saving and Versions](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [Singleplayer Contract](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## Processing Order and Responsibility Boundaries

1. Check the rule and ledger revisions within the same save boundary as the permanent identity.
2. Check survival, body, detention, and safety, authority, location and delivery, resources and reservations, and consent.
3. Distinguish the actual fulfillment of food and water, and check the original injury or fatigue cause and the existing settlement references.
4. A transition that requires an unapproved method, consumption rate, recovery rate, or threshold ends with a pending error.
5. Only exactly approved transitions are applied, together with the state and the cause and effect references. The detailed update order of body → needs → mood is still only a proposal.

## Normalized Data and Formula Contract

Declare together the owner, read/write scope, units, snapshot, and point of application. Validation of formats and conservation formulas does not substitute for actual ledger issuance or the adoption of undecided functions. rulesVersion and the hash of the linked canonical source identify the source version and do not create any arbitrary new execution version.

# D02 건강·욕구·부상·치료 작동 계약과 공식 시트

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다.

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/characters-and-persons/)

현재 신체는 왼팔·오른팔·왼다리·오른다리·머리·몸통의 여섯 부위로 기록한다. 손상 정도와 기능 상태를 구분하고 질병 진행 상태도 별도로 둔다. 전투와 역병은 동일한 신체 기록에 영향을 준다. 아래 HP·FP 필드와 참조식은 과거 또는 연구 범위이며 새 체계의 필수 집계식이 아니다. 식량·물·욕구·기분은 별도 상태다. 치료 요청과 실제 수행을 구분하며 같은 원인·효과를 중복 정산하지 않는다. 손상·기능 어휘와 질병·회복·불능·사망 수치 규칙은 아직 미확정이다.

상태: 범위가 한정된 작동 계약. 공개 Lite의 참조 계산, 서울의 승인된 절차·보존 규칙, 미승인 제안을 구분한다. proposal-held는 실행할 수 없는 보류 항목이며 0이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 이 문서는 전체 도메인 수치 완성이나 런타임 구현을 뜻하지 않는다.

[도메인 설계](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d02/) · [개인 시트와 계산](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [저장과 판본](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [싱글플레이 계약](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 처리 순서와 책임 경계

1. 영구 신원과 같은 저장 경계의 규칙·원장 개정을 확인한다.
2. 생존·신체·구금·안전, 권한, 장소·전달, 자원·예약과 동의를 검사한다.
3. 식량과 물의 실제 이행을 구분하고 원래 부상·피로 원인 및 기존 정산 참조를 확인한다.
4. 미승인 방법·소모율·회복률·임계값이 필요한 전이는 보류 오류로 종료한다.
5. 정확히 승인된 전이만 상태와 원인·효과 참조를 함께 반영한다. 신체→욕구→기분의 세부 갱신 순서는 아직 제안이다.

## 정규화된 데이터·공식 계약

소유자, 읽기·쓰기 범위, 단위, 스냅샷과 반영 시점을 함께 선언한다. 형식과 보존식의 검증은 실제 원장 발급이나 미정 함수의 채택을 대신하지 않는다. rulesVersion과 연결 정본의 해시는 원천 판본을 식별하며 임의의 새 실행 판본을 만들지 않는다.

body_md:
# D03 Command, Authority, Consent, and Reservation Operating Contract and Official Sheet

## Game Logic Overhaul Alignment Boundary

This document retains its existing proposal status. The formulas, tables, and blueprints are neither implementation facts of Seoul nor approved figures. The Seoul-fact / CK3-reference / product-authority distinctions in the linked chapters below and SP-1.0.0 take precedence, and undecided values are not interpreted as 0 or any arbitrary default. The deep-survey discrepancy totals and clan formulas are not adopted.

[Corresponding Chapters and Confirmed Grounds](/gdd/rules/game-logic-principles/)

A command separately verifies the sender, recipient, scope, channel, validity period, actual delivery, consent, and resources. Revoking authority or replacing a command releases only unconsumed reservations and preserves completed progress and consumption. Favorable reactions or high command skill do not substitute for consent.

Status: a scoped operating contract. It distinguishes the public Lite's reference calculations, Seoul's approved procedures and preservation rules, and unapproved proposals. A proposal-held item is a deferred entry that cannot be executed, and it is neither 0 nor an approved figure. This document does not imply full-domain numerical completion or a runtime implementation.

[Domain Design](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d03/) · [Personal Sheet and Calculations](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [Saving and Versions](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [Single-Player Contract](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## Processing Order and Responsibility Boundaries

1. Verifies the input format, permanent ID, rules version, resource units, and conserved quantities.
2. Only an exact resend of the original request returns the existing receipt; altered duplicates and outdated versions are rejected.
3. On cancellation, death, or valid revocation, completed progress and consumption are retained and only unconsumed reservations are released.
4. Strategic delivery requires an actual route and receipt; combat delivery requires a registered attachment and a signal at the same world time.
5. At execution, the delegated scope, start≤now<end, and physical, safety, detention, and on-site conditions are rechecked.
6. Without explicit consent, a hold, refusal, or negotiation state is recorded. Clearing an obstacle is merely a request for a recheck, not automatic execution.
7. By designating the previous command, only a replacement that has been actually delivered, approved, and accepted atomically exchanges the remaining reservations.

## Normalized Data and Formula Contract

Declare together the owner, read/write scope, units, snapshot, and point of application. Validation of formats and conservation formulas does not substitute for actual ledger issuance or the adoption of undecided functions. rulesVersion and the hash of the linked canonical source identify the source version and do not create any arbitrary new execution version.

# D03 명령·권한·동의·예약 작동 계약과 공식 시트

## 게임 로직 개편 정합 경계

이 문서는 기존 제안 상태를 유지한다. 산식·표·청사진은 서울의 구현 사실이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 아래 연결된 장의 서울 사실/CK3 참조/제품 권한 구분과 SP-1.0.0이 우선하며 미정 값을 0 또는 임의 기본값으로 해석하지 않는다. 깊이조사의 불일치 총계·씨족 산식은 채택하지 않는다.

[대응 장과 확인된 근거](/gdd/rules/game-logic-principles/)

명령은 발신자·수신자·범위·채널·유효기간·실제 전달·동의·자원을 각각 확인한다. 권한 철회와 명령 교체는 미소비 예약만 해제하며 완료 진척과 소비를 보존한다. 호의적 반응이나 높은 지휘 기술은 동의를 대신하지 않는다.

상태: 범위가 한정된 작동 계약. 공개 Lite의 참조 계산, 서울의 승인된 절차·보존 규칙, 미승인 제안을 구분한다. proposal-held는 실행할 수 없는 보류 항목이며 0이나 승인 수치가 아니다. 이 문서는 전체 도메인 수치 완성이나 런타임 구현을 뜻하지 않는다.

[도메인 설계](/gdd/system-design/mechanism-design-index-d03/) · [개인 시트와 계산](/gdd/system-design/character-sheet-formulas/) · [저장과 판본](/gdd/rules/save-and-determinism/) · [싱글플레이 계약](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 처리 순서와 책임 경계

1. 입력 형식·영구 ID·규칙 판본·자원 단위·보존량을 확인한다.
2. 원 요청의 정확한 재전송만 기존 영수증을 돌려주며 변경된 중복과 낡은 판본은 거부한다.
3. 취소·사망·유효한 철회 시 완료 진척과 소비는 유지하고 미소비 예약만 해제한다.
4. 전략 전달은 실제 경로·수령, 전투 전달은 등록된 배속과 동일 세계시각 신호를 요구한다.
5. 실행 시 위임 범위와 start≤now<end, 신체·안전·구금·현장 조건을 재검사한다.
6. 명시적 동의가 없으면 보류·거절·협상 상태를 기록한다. 장애 해소는 재검사 요청일 뿐 자동 실행이 아니다.
7. 이전 명령을 지목하여 실제 전달·승인·수락된 교체만 잔여 예약을 원자적으로 교환한다.

## 정규화된 데이터·공식 계약

소유자, 읽기·쓰기 범위, 단위, 스냅샷과 반영 시점을 함께 선언한다. 형식과 보존식의 검증은 실제 원장 발급이나 미정 함수의 채택을 대신하지 않는다. rulesVersion과 연결 정본의 해시는 원천 판본을 식별하며 임의의 새 실행 판본을 만들지 않는다.
